              const WCC01 = document.getElementById('sponsor-countdown-ad');

              window.googletag = window.googletag || {};
              window.googletag.cmd = window.googletag.cmd || [];
              window.googletag.cmd.push(() => {
                // WCC01 is on the page, so add an event listener for it
                if (WCC01) {
                  let wcc01CheckIsComplete = false;
                  googletag.pubads().addEventListener('slotRenderEnded', (event) => {
                    if (!wcc01CheckIsComplete && !event.isEmpty) {
                      // we re-declare document.getElementById('sponsor-countdown-ad') instead of using the WCC01 var because the htl ad contents didn't exist when the var was first instantiated
                      if (document.getElementById('sponsor-countdown-ad').contains(document.getElementById(event.slot.getSlotElementId()))) {
                        // trigger the event that the countdown clock is waiting for, to display the ad container
                        document.dispatchEvent(new Event('WCC01_Flighted'));
                        wcc01CheckIsComplete = true;
                      }
                    }
                  });
                }

                // Dispatching event for Gallery AD
                googletag.pubads().addEventListener('slotRenderEnded', (event) => {
                  const PG02 = document.querySelector('#sponsor-gallery_d-t');
                  if (PG02 && PG02.contains(document.getElementById(event.slot.getSlotElementId())) && !event.isEmpty) {
                    document.dispatchEvent(new Event('PG02_Flighted'));
                  }
                });

                // Dispatching event for Recipe AD
                googletag.pubads().addEventListener('slotRenderEnded', (event) => {
                  const WR01 = document.querySelector('#sponsor-recipes');
                  if (WR01 && WR01.contains(document.getElementById(event.slot.getSlotElementId())) && !event.isEmpty) {
                    document.dispatchEvent(new Event('WR01_Flighted'));
                  }
                });

                let hs01CheckIsComplete = false;
                let HS01, HS02;

                const HS01callback = (event) => {
                  if (!hs01CheckIsComplete) {
                    if (HS01?.contains(document.getElementById(event.slot.getSlotElementId()))) {
                      // it's HS01, so check the render state and act on HS02 accordingly
                      const navBN = document.querySelector('.nav-breaking-news');
                      if (!event.isEmpty) {
                        // HS01 rendered, add a class to the breaking news navbar container to ensure a margin above BN bar
                        navBN.classList += ' is-below-shade';
                      } else if (HS02) {
                        // HS01 did NOT render, so remove the  HS02 "blocker"
                        const HS02Parent = document.querySelector('.c-HS02');
                        HS02Parent.setAttribute('class', HS02Parent.getAttribute('class').replace('has-wallpaper', ''));
                      }
                      navBN.classList += ' hs01checkComplete';
                      hs01CheckIsComplete = true;
                      observer.disconnect();
                    }
                  }
                };

                const observeElements = () => {
                  HS01 = document.getElementById('top-half-shade');
                  HS02 = document.getElementById('inline-peekthrough');

                  if (HS01 && HS02) {
                    googletag.pubads().addEventListener('slotRenderEnded', (event) => HS01callback(event));
                  } else if (HS01) {
                    googletag.pubads().addEventListener('slotRenderEnded', (event) => HS01callback(event));
                  } else if (HS02) {
                    const HS02Parent = document.querySelector('.c-HS02');
                    HS02Parent.setAttribute('class', HS02Parent.getAttribute('class').replace('has-wallpaper', ''));
                    observer.disconnect();
                  }
                };

                const observer = new MutationObserver(observeElements);
                const observerConfig = { childList: true, subtree: true };
                observer.observe(document.body, observerConfig);

                observeElements();
              });

came down to the very end."},{"_id":"5TRLMLCR3BFC3PVUDLBSTBZS4Y","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"The Hawks, looking to bounce back from their disastrous outing in Detroit, needed all 48 minutes of the game to down the 76ers 120-117 on Sunday at State Farm Arena"},{"_id":"EI754N53RRCKHKRT2P7TGXR3XE","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Hawks Nickeil Alexander-Walker, who almost missed Sunday’s action with a right lateral ankle sprain, hit two clutch free throws to give the Hawks just enough of a cushion. They led just 118-117 after 76ers guard Quentin Grimes hit a tightly contested 3 by Vit Krejci with a minute to play."},{"_id":"PMBUWUUXTFBWBO64PZ7RY2IQMQ","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"But the Hawks forced the 76ers to go 0-of-2 from the field on their go-ahead attempts before Alexander-Walker was fouled. "},{"_id":"V3DZRIECLNAVLDVLURANS3FGSE","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“It was big tonight,” Hawks forward Jalen Johnson said. “Dyson (Daniels) played great. Zacch (Risacher) played great. There’s so many guys that played great. Obviously, shots weren’t falling for me and Nickeil tonight, that just shows you how deep our team is, and guys stepped up when we needed them all. So that was big.”"},{"_id":"755LPIJGQVDARKS36VOUMMLAXI","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"<b>Quick stats:</b> Daniels had 27 points and 10 rebounds. Hawks center Onyeka Okongwu had his sixth double-double of the season, finishing with 20 points, 15 rebounds. Zaccharie Risacher scored 15 points while Vit Krejci had 19 points off the bench."},{"_id":"YPMXB7ZKFVB3DJRHTNUVJRJYHM","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Jalen Johnson (12 points, 10 rebounds, 12 assists) finished with fourth consecutive triple-double."},{"level":2,"_id":"SX2IIW7VI5HCBEEBYGEK3VEE2I","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"header","content":"Key moment"},{"_id":"YIJYTPHQNJDF7L4Y2E2GGHMF7Q","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Late in the game, the Hawks successfully challenged an out of bounds call that officials initially ruled 76ers ball. With 2.5 to play in the game, the Hawks looked to run a sideline out of bounds play but after the 76ers defense left the Hawks no options, Johnson had to call timeout to prevent a turnover."},{"_id":"GUXNFHTCNNBJDOXQ6HU6T2N5DA","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"After the timeout the Hawks looked to run the play again and Johnson got the ball inbounds with Alexander-Walker heading into the backcourt, where he was fouled."},{"_id":"OI47DDKF5RBGJAPXGXWTJKWX7A","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"The 76ers argued that officials should have called a backcourt violation, but they’d burned their challenge earlier in the quarter and officials did not review the call. Alexander-Walker went the line and sank two free throws."},{"level":2,"_id":"EFD3R3LQ5ZBWRLTYO4STAJCSXY","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"header","content":"Highlight play "},{"_id":"NHLXSUWJJVEATD2KQAEYXDGQ7U","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Okongwu did a little of everything Sunday. 12-14","width":3492,"_id":"LNIZVTXXERHNJJ2JQK66HYTD5Y","created_date":"2025-12-14T21:57:48Z","resized_obj":{"src":"https://www.ajc.com/resizer/v2/LNIZVTXXERHNJJ2JQK66HYTD5Y.jpg?auth=30e15394dc5901b039dd320751fbe8db37f95658ceef180ee01937136b1ce5b0&width=1260&height=840&smart=true"}}},{"content_elements":[{"_id":"4EFJYMXNY5HA3G5NDZU3K5CTTM","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"After four exhausting overtimes, countless swings of momentum and one final, breath-stealing defensive stand, South Carolina State outlasted Prairie View A&amp;M 40-38 on Saturday afternoon inside Mercedes-Benz Stadium to claim the Celebration Bowl and the HBCU national championship."},{"_id":"EUSHOGMGMBA25KE2BUHRNDCL6A","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“It’s been a journey,” Bulldogs head coach Chennis Berry said after Saturday’s win. “I’m very demanding of our coaches, never demeaning, but demanding, because I know what the expectations are in our program. … A lot of people in this room probably didn’t believe in us. "},{"_id":"4QCTYNVK5ZERFDVGOW7OVTKLRA","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“ … You guys may have picked us to win it this year, but you really didn’t because we returned one starter on offense and two on defense. … It’s like, I’m still dreaming. Man, but I know this is what God has for us. When God is for you. Nobody can be against you.”"},{"_id":"JOYSIX4TBJCFBFD2S24ZZJ7JUQ","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"The victory secured the Bulldogs’ second Celebration Bowl title in program history and delivered a measure of redemption for Berry, now in his second season at South Carolina State. A year earlier, the Bulldogs unraveled on the same stage, falling 28-7 to SWAC champion Jackson State. For much of Saturday’s game, history appeared ready to repeat itself. Prairie View carried a 21-0 lead into halftime, and the Panthers seemed firmly in control. "},{"_id":"XFJ7CDFY5RCQHOMV3NAXSNMWRQ","additional_properties":{"nofollow":false,"selectedStory":false,"sponsored":false,"openInNewTab":true},"type":"interstitial_link","content":"On college football’s HBCU stage, two champions arrive from different paths","url":"https://www.ajc.com/sports/2025/12/on-college-footballs-hbcu-stage-two-champions-arrive-from-different-paths/"},{"_id":"WNUXSHCHKNB6JAUHBRKMPAN6KU","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"But this time, the script changed. What followed after halftime was not another collapse, but a slow-burning surge built on resolve, belief and resilience, a layered comeback that turned struggle into triumph and left SCSU standing alone atop the HBCU landscape."},{"_id":"T3QHAVADNNGRRJSTCN7JEQJXBQ","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"For the Bulldogs, the turnaround did not begin with a fiery speech. Berry, known for his supercharged motivational addresses, kept it simple in the locker room. He spoke briefly, asking only for total commitment, every ounce of energy his players could give."},{"_id":"D63SRSEFKFAITDNFIJTTH2D3G4","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“We just told each other, put your body on the line for this game,” said Bulldogs defensive back and Celebration Bowl defensive MVP Brenyen Scott after Saturday’s victory. “You never know if you could have tomorrow. You never know if you can have next season.”"},{"_id":"CIEBFJJIQNCINKJIIINUTQ3LFE","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"That mindset carried South Carolina State through one of the most dramatic second halves in Celebration Bowl history. The Bulldogs, who entered the game 5-0 this season in contests decided by one score or fewer, began chipping away at Prairie View’s 21-0 halftime lead with a relentless third-quarter surge. "},{"_id":"UJP7FBZ5FBEP3LQ26IABFDOL2Y","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"South Carolina State scored 21 unanswered points in the period, fueled by a pivotal turnover deep in Prairie View territory when Panthers running back Chase Bingmon lost the ball near his own end zone. The Bulldogs capitalized on the short field with a touchdown on the ensuing possession, one of two scores in the quarter by Jordan Smith."},{"_id":"C2LAI625RVCF5NPH2FNXYYUR4E","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"By the time regulation ended, South Carolina State had outscored Prairie View 35-14 after halftime, but the Bulldogs still had to earn their second HBCU national title in overtime."},{"_id":"VGECEVUKGBAURK742ZKOXF4FGU","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Both teams traded field goals in the first extra period. Prairie View’s Diego Alfaro connected from 29 yards, only to see Nico Cavanillas Alti answer with a dramatic 40-yarder to tie the game at 38-all. "},{"_id":"FTT3WX2RFBF3ZPCTYRZ6ZBKGSE","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"The second overtime brought another swing of emotion when Bulldogs defensive back Cornelius Davis intercepted quarterback Ryan Stubblefield’s pass — his first interception of the season — giving SCSU an opportunity to end it. Instead, Alfaro pushed a 31-yard attempt wide right, extending the game."},{"_id":"WB5IZ334FZEBBEECXGIZ5ZNBA4","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Neither team could convert a two-point attempt in the third overtime, setting the stage for a fourth overtime. The Bulldogs struck first when Stubblefield delivered a pass to Tyler Smith on a play that drew immediate controversy. After review, the catch stood, with Smith stretching the ball just inside the orange pylon for the decisive two-point conversion."},{"_id":"WBCMOJXQIZB5PCQ7G6R6KJFS7E","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Prairie View had one final chance. Panthers quarterback Cameron Peters, who finished 24 of 36 for a Celebration Bowl-record 412 yards and four touchdowns, surpassing <a href=\"https://www.ajc.com/sports/college/2020-celebration-bowl-north-carolina-alcorn-state/Ta65W6SEnNPwAUJiM162WJ/\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"\" title=\"https://www.ajc.com/sports/college/2020-celebration-bowl-north-carolina-alcorn-state/Ta65W6SEnNPwAUJiM162WJ/\">North Carolina A&amp;T’s Kylil Carter’s 2019 mark (364 yards)</a>, dropped back one last time. His pass fell incomplete. "},{"_id":"BD3IQAB2YFCFVAUNR7QAV33UYI","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"In that moment, the Bulldogs’ comeback was complete, the redemption secured and South Carolina State’s mission fulfilled, a championship earned."},{"_id":"BY3KMYA4WZA3JHSIHOLUCTBOSA","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“ (Last year), I stood right by our locker room outside, still in the stadium, and I watched confetti drop on another team, and that fueled me,” Berry said. “I said, ‘if the good Lord gives me another opportunity, that confetti will not drop on another team. That confetti is going to drop on us (Bulldogs),’ and that motivated us. "},{"_id":"FFOAFQ5O2RBPLCAOPDIH7XVUZI","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“We always start our season, when you look at last year’s PowerPoint presentation, it had Mercedes-Benz Stadium. But nothing else was on it. This year, it had Mercedes-Benz Stadium, all right, but it had that trophy next to it. … Speak what you seek until you see what you say. We knew what we would be here, but we wanted to walk away this time with a trophy in hand. … We did just that.”"},{"_id":"VIVC4XHFFRG7ZBQ4T7NV2S75OY","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Before halftime, the game belonged entirely to Prairie View A&amp;M, building a 21-0 lead and leaving South Carolina State searching for answers. Cameron Peters led one of the game’s defining first-half drives late in the second quarter, guiding an 11-play, 95-yard drive that ended with him delivering a 14-yard touchdown pass to Jyzaiah Rockwell, a fitting exclamation point on a half in which Prairie View controlled every phase of the game."},{"_id":"25CSOBPE5FBZ3L5RYZZ74MHFTU","additional_properties":{"nofollow":false,"selectedStory":false,"sponsored":false,"openInNewTab":true},"type":"interstitial_link","content":"Jackson State wins Celebration Bowl for HBCU national championship","url":"https://www.ajc.com/sports/state-sports/jackson-state-wins-celebration-bowl-for-hbcu-national-championship/MHDVRON7URFQBMCD53FFJAHO4E/"},{"_id":"EC5SHVVJ4VAM5DOPVFNCUR2IWI","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"The Panthers’ defense set the tone early and never relented, smothering South Carolina State’s offense and limiting the Bulldogs to just 80 yards of total offense in the first half. South Carolina State managed only six first downs and converted just 4-of-9 third-down attempts, despite narrowly winning the time-of-possession battle. Bulldogs signal-caller William Atkins completed 7-of-9 passes for 45 yards before a hand injury forced him out before the Bulldogs’ final drive of the half, sending backup Stubblefield into the game."},{"_id":"YK4XU7FXG5DVPNAEAUFORUDOFQ","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Nothing came easily for South Carolina State. The Bulldogs punted on five of their first-half possessions and consistently worked with short fields, averaging a starting position at their own 27-yard line."},{"_id":"LI3RJPGNTNHL7IPIQ5DSJS46FA","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"The Panthers seized momentum early in the second quarter. Beginning a drive at its own 15-yard line, Prairie View marched steadily downfield before Peters kept the ball on a designed run, bursting through the middle of the defense and sprinting 27 yards to the end zone for the Panthers’ second touchdown."},{"_id":"4M5224NMUBBA5I5RI7C4XGC4UY","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Prairie View’s offensive rhythm had been established even earlier. After Diego Alfaro missed a field goal on the Panthers’ second possession, the Panthers responded with a sharp six-play, 69-yard drive. Peters connected with Jeremiah Ratliff for 17 yards, then delivered a 38-yard strike to Andre Dennis to move the ball to the Bulldogs’ 16. "},{"_id":"CHFWCEYDXVHHHPAE4TBZ24F5N4","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Two plays later, Peters found tight end Ethan John streaking free for a 16-yard touchdown, opening the scoring and setting the tone for a dominant first half."}],"subheadlines":{"basic":"Bulldogs rally from 21-point deficit to defeat Prairie View A&M in Celebration Bowl, 40-38."},"description":{"basic":"South Carolina State rallied from 21 down against Prairie View A&M to win 40-38 in four overtimes, taking home the HBCU national championship. "},{"_id":"WQV5QB57GFAOPGO2FMQEH4JVTY","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Pair the layoff with the aura surrounding an NBA arena, and history proves slow starts are common for Georgia. It experienced a similar situation in 2024 when it returned from an 11-day break to face Grand Canyon in Holiday Hoopsgiving, in the same venue it played Cincinnati. The Bulldogs eked out a 73-68 victory before steamrolling Buffalo by 51 points five days later."},{"_id":"D3B3S33M7NB5DOTXXK4ZDNMPRA","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“Sometimes these environments can be difficult for young people,” White said. “I don’t think we handled that level of communication as well as we did two days ago (in practice).” "},{"_id":"O336VLZTUBETLPV6GXN7BL25CY","additional_properties":{"nofollow":false,"selectedStory":false,"sponsored":false,"openInNewTab":true},"type":"interstitial_link","content":"Jeremiah Wilkinson thriving in Georgia basketball’s offense","url":"https://www.ajc.com/sports/2025/11/jeremiah-wilkinson-thriving-in-georgia-basketballs-offense/"},{"_id":"3DNPYZPMT5FYJDICFTWKA65QFE","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"To combat the time off, the Bulldogs stepped up their already competitive scrimmages. It culminated with a practice on Thursday that junior guard Blue Cain deemed as “one of our best practices I’ve ever been a part of.” "},{"_id":"RZ7ARQ5Q7RGDZAS3NNS7EOURKY","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Georgia demonstrated excellent accountability, edge, passion and competitive spirit during the scrimmage — in the words of White — and although it didn’t translate early against the Bearcats, Cain believes it paved the way for the Bulldogs’ victory."},{"_id":"GWDDS2PSR5ECTFCKGMBMDXQP7E","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“It helped us win today’s game,” Cain said. “Even if we came out a little lackadaisical, I thought (the practice) was very similar to a game in terms of the intensity and focus. That was good, just kind of get us back into the playing mode.”"},{"_id":"HNVLS3OVXJCCZAGLZV4UKCJ5QI","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Georgia did not make a basket until Cincinnati had a 4-0 lead with around 18 minutes left in the first half. The Bulldogs were outscored 18-9 to begin the game and later faced an 11-point deficit with eight minutes before halftime. "},{"_id":"7ODKCTSPLJGW5LOCBMKPF46NQ4","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Georgia rallied and went on a 13-1 run to draw even at the break. It then outscored Cincinnati, 47-28, in the second half to earn the hard-fought win. "},{"_id":"FITVJPZZFBGZBIO5LXAUBXHGMU","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“One of our keys going into it was — they’re very physical defensively, and we wanted to kind of match their physicality on offense,” Cain said. “Early on, I thought we weren’t doing great, but I thought as the game went along, we really matched their physicality.”"},{"_id":"VRNWZR3K6RDZJLTCA4F2MJHOEM","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Cain led Georgia with a career-high 22 points, while sophomore guard Jeremiah Wilkinson notched 17. Four Bulldogs finished with double digit points, including sophomore center Somto Cyril and junior guard Marcus “Smurf” Millender. "},{"_id":"VQAGGT34ZVFIZPF4AHUBQ5RYEI","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“I just try to let the game come to me,” said Cain, who earned 12 of his 22 points on free throws."},{"_id":"OUJISZ7MJZDHHORTVJQHJXMUUU","additional_properties":{"nofollow":false,"selectedStory":false,"sponsored":false,"openInNewTab":true},"type":"interstitial_link","content":"Georgia basketball leaning on depth early in season","url":"https://www.ajc.com/sports/2025/12/georgia-basketball-leaning-on-depth-early-in-season/"},{"_id":"PJAARFCG25G3ZFL3VJLRXA3QGY","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"The Bulldogs struggled from beyond the arc, as their first nine 3-point attempts fell flat. Sophomore forward Kanon Catchings earned Georgia’s first make with around 17 minutes remaining in the game. The seconds before he took the shot marked the Bulldogs’ last time trailing in the contest. "},{"_id":"YDLE6U4VVJG6PDQV2YUTC4LXFQ","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Georgia showed it could overcome unfavorable circumstances with the win. The Bulldogs turned the ball over 10 times in the first half and shot 19% from the 3-point line for the game, but still earned a 19-point victory — their largest on a neutral site since defeating Georgia Southern by 21 points in 2001. "},{"_id":"OACXEZUL55ABPOGRCR4Y4T4PTM","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"And the outcome displayed the potential of a Georgia team who looked like it had not played in 11 days. "},{"_id":"PDWPCFAPJRDJVIBM7E3JCHY5F4","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“I think we have a high ceiling,” White said. “Our ceiling’s higher than it is right now. She is entering her fourth-year at the University of Georgia, where she is earning a degree in journalism with a minor in sport management and a sports media certificate. and Carrollton, who boast a combined 21 state titles, both have a chance to claim their first national championship when they clash in the Class 6A final on Tuesday. "},{"_id":"J5FHYKXOAVC57GHZUIK6NSDMZQ","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"The Wolves and Trojans both enter the game at 14-0 with impressive wins along the way. Buford opened the season with four straight wins over No. 3 Milton, No. 2 Benedictine, No. 6 Roswell and No. 4 Douglas County before kicking off region play. Carrollton beat No. 3 Gainesville, No. 6 Douglas County, No. 10 Harrison, No. 1 Grayson and No. 8 North Gwinnett throughout the season. "},{"_id":"PSXLRCQ34ZHTDIRGCWVIZS3BHM","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Buford has won 14 state titles, three of which came under seventh-year coach Bryant Appling. The Wolves have also won five region championships since Appling took over. "},{"_id":"YBYXTLQIDNGNPGYBWB77CWJ7BU","additional_properties":{"nofollow":false,"selectedStory":false,"sponsored":false,"openInNewTab":true},"type":"interstitial_link","content":"Maxwell AAAAA semifinal predictions: Look for two close battles to advance to the championship","url":"https://www.ajc.com/sports/2025/12/maxwell-aaaaa-semifinal-predictions-look-for-two-close-battles-to-advance-to-the-championship/"},{"_id":"HYKMC6NVV5BVZE35WVABFHDQCM","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Buford also boasts one of the most talented rosters in the country, headlined by AJC Super 11 selection Tyriq Green. The future University of Georgia safety leads a ferocious defense with Texas A&amp;M defensive lineman signee Bryce Perry-Wright and Ohio State edge signee Dre Quinn. Three-star junior quarterback Dayton Raiola leads an offense stacked with future Power 4 players. "},{"_id":"NSCKA3JDC5BBTM2XLTGMWEQ4PI","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Carrollton has won seven titles, though its last came in 1998. The Trojans have made the state championship three of the past four years and beat Buford 30-17 last season to get there. Carrollton has won four consecutive region championships under fifth-year coach Joey King. "},{"_id":"LFL3XPJ56RBQLK4UZW22V5SOZM","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Two UGA signees headline Carrollton’s offense: 4-star receiver Ryan Mosley and 3-star offensive lineman Zykie Helton. Four-star Ole Miss cornerback signee Dorian Barney leads a defense full of future FBS players."},{"_id":"3SQASU7IOJESBHNLSLENQLJBKY","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Both teams have won with enough dominance to be in contention for national championships from several media polls. Although there is no single national championship game in high school football, outlets that release rankings all season name the No. 1 team at the end of the season their “national champion.”"},{"_id":"R7PKEHXQQFGYRNFGISINBQJ3W4","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Many outlets rank Buford and Carrollton high enough that the winner of the Class 6A state championship could finish the season at No. 1, winning their first national championship."},{"_id":"YQ3F3ENFMZAJNPDRBG6NWYNMH4","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[{"date":"2025-12-11T19:49:56.982Z","replies":[],"pos":74,"comment":" many polls like","isNote":true,"type":"insert","user":"NANCY CLANTON","email":"Nancy.Clanton@coxinc.com"}],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Last season, Mater Dei (California) was named the national championship by USA Today, High School Football America, SBLive, MaxPreps and other polls. The Monarchs went 13-0 with wins over national powerhouses like Bishop Gorman (Nevada), Santa Margarita (California), Saint Frances Academy (Maryland), Saint John Bosco (California) and De La Salle (California)."},{"_id":"QVPVCAK74RGXHLGCOLWQU33RLU","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Georgia’s 2024 Class 5A champion, Milton, did win <a href=\"https://www.georgiahighschoolfootballdaily.com/main-news/milton-named-high-school-football-america-public-school-national-champion#:~:text=Milton%20named%20High%20School%20Football,Dei%20of%20Orange%20County%2C%20Calif.\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"\" title=\"https://www.georgiahighschoolfootballdaily.com/main-news/milton-named-high-school-football-america-public-school-national-champion#:~:text=Milton%20named%20High%20School%20Football,Dei%20of%20Orange%20County%2C%20Calif.\">High School Football America’s public school national title</a>. Other recent Georgia national champions include 2015 Colquitt County (HSFA), 2011 Calhoun (MaxPreps Small School) and 2002 Parkview (USAHSF)."},{"_id":"LAA2X4LN4FHZJJINDQ5PMKL6MM","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[{"date":"2025-12-11T19:51:00.784Z","replies":[],"pos":98,"comment":" TODAY","isNote":true,"type":"insert","user":"NANCY CLANTON","email":"Nancy.Clanton@coxinc.com"}],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Georgia has not had a consensus No. 1 since 1991, when LaGrange was named national champion by USA Today."},{"_id":"FEUF2XVGZ5HTRAM5ZVXSDGCPGM","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Final top 25 polls won’t release until Texas finishes its playoffs Dec. 20. Most polls will announce a national champion in the following couple of days."},{"_id":"A4ODMIQWU5EK5LWZN3C4YOUIXE","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Contributors from USA Today, MaxPreps, High School Football America and SBLive all explained how Buford or Carrollton can win a national championship Tuesday. "},{"_id":"SYEHK5TDRFEGRDEF57MJSRI5EM","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"USA Today is the longest-running active poll at 43 years. MaxPreps’ poll started in 2005, High School Football America started in 2012 and SBLive started in 2020."},{"level":2,"_id":"2OGSW3ZCUVFPNC33OESOJLGWI4","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"header","content":"USA Today: ‘Consistency is always key’"},{"_id":"QQ6UR5GDRREA3NEGEE5MBMDPBU","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"<b>Rankings: No. 1 Buford, No. 2 Carrollton </b>"},{"_id":"YPFIOEQD2ZALNAKWGVRNIYLGFA","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Tuesday night’s game in Mercedes-Benz Stadium is a true national championship in the eyes of USA Today’s poll, which ranks Buford and Carrollton at No. 1 and No. 2, respectively. "},{"_id":"OZPLOMER4ZGCLJ7AEVF5ENMTKM","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[{"date":"2025-12-11T19:56:13.005Z","replies":[],"pos":65,"comment":" throughout the season","isNote":true,"type":"insert","user":"NANCY CLANTON","email":"Nancy.Clanton@coxinc.com"}],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Buford started the season in the top 10 and slowly made up ground. Carrollton started at No. 24 and had moved up only to No. 11 by late November. "},{"_id":"3IX5RBXZZZEWTKWULMNUZ5PP4M","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[{"date":"2025-12-11T19:56:39.040Z","replies":[],"pos":67,"comment":" from there","isNote":true,"type":"insert","user":"NANCY CLANTON","email":"Nancy.Clanton@coxinc.com"}],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Then the Trojans hammered Grayson 34-14, and they moved up to No. 4. "},{"_id":"WNYQTHQFIFFT3ARJBMORNOXY3M","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“With Buford and Carrollton, it’s like, these guys are clearly a class above others when it comes to being able to control the competition,” USA Today senior content strategist Rick Suter said. "},{"_id":"O6JWENZBK5FYRHF3T4BBN5VEQE","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[{"date":"2025-12-11T19:58:03.526Z","replies":[],"pos":55,"comment":" like","isNote":true,"type":"insert","user":"NANCY CLANTON","email":"Nancy.Clanton@coxinc.com"},{"date":"2025-12-11T19:58:28.812Z","replies":[],"pos":83,"comment":" (California)","isNote":true,"type":"insert","user":"NANCY CLANTON","email":"Nancy.Clanton@coxinc.com"},{"date":"2025-12-11T19:58:45.647Z","replies":[],"pos":104,"comment":" (Maryland)","isNote":true,"type":"insert","user":"NANCY CLANTON","email":"Nancy.Clanton@coxinc.com"},{"date":"2025-12-11T19:58:50.831Z","replies":[],"pos":122,"comment":" (Nevada)","isNote":true,"type":"insert","user":"NANCY CLANTON","email":"Nancy.Clanton@coxinc.com"}],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Unexpected losses from annual national title contenders Mater Dei, Saint John Bosco, St. Frances Academy and Bishop Gorman opened the door for the undefeated Georgia teams. "},{"_id":"CEA2UKZ3G5AIFCZJBR7XGHPFIU","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“Consistency is always key to me,” Suter said. “When you’re looking at being able to have that sort of dominance week in and week out, showing that sort of growth. Obviously, they’ve got a really talented roster with both of those schools. "},{"_id":"5J3CKCPNCRFHJHAJDUWSGCKGSY","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“Being able to show that kind of consistency that they did over those teams is what had us moving them forward.” "},{"_id":"WW46N7FD6ZEADHNJN2CJZWV7ZU","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Suter doesn’t decide the rankings on his own, but he knows exactly where his national champion vote will go after Tuesday night. "},{"_id":"GBWODQYUPFCVPGKA2LY6ZKFEWE","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“The winner of that game, to me, is the national champion,” Suter said. “From the body of work, showing the consistency … I don’t see any surprises coming.” "},{"_id":"BRAXH2MJKBGHPFLV5YBQUFL754","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"LaGrange (1991) and Valdosta (1986, 1984) are the only Georgia schools to win USA Today’s national title."},{"level":2,"_id":"OIRKSA2BJVFIBNLK2VAEGASQQE","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"header","content":"MaxPreps: Zeroing in on quality wins"},{"_id":"MA3JHKMPIRD4FELFTNTL7YR3VA","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"<b>Rankings: No. 1 Carrollton No. 6 Buford </b>"},{"_id":"KEHDLAOESZAUZCO3SILO7D3NHA","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"A Carrollton win would likely make the Trojans the MaxPreps national champion. Buford does sit behind several other national title contenders, but the Wolves can certainly make their case to finish at No. 1 on Tuesday night. "},{"_id":"HCXJ2RPPVVBXREYVVXIKFDBD5Q","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"National football editor Zachary Poff wants to see Carrollton and Buford differentiate themselves from one other undefeated contender, No. 3-ranked Southlake Carroll (Texas). Southlake Carroll is 14-0 and will face No. 64-ranked DeSoto in the UIL Class 6A Division 2 semifinals Saturday. "},{"_id":"FMKJEKCXB5GOHOMSLA6XN4ZUJ4","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Southlake Carroll would advance to face either Vandergrift or King in the state championship. Vandergrift is ranked No. 95 nationally, and King is unranked. "},{"_id":"7UFUYZ3LL5E5NG4WHUVFHOFPWE","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"So, a Buford win over the poll’s top-ranked team could be plenty strong enough to claim the No. 1 spot. But Poff said the way Buford would potentially beat Carrollton also matters. "},{"_id":"STZC4OAKJRB6JJEFIFETKGLIG4","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“If Buford absolutely dominates Carrollton, that’s going to go a long way,” Poff said. “If Buford wins a close game, and it’s kind of Carrollton beating themselves a little bit, that might open the door a little more. It all depends on watching the games and how they play out.” "},{"_id":"K4ESJ2GMDFET3C7VMELIGVN6XA","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"MaxPreps has already shown it has no issue bumping a team up several spots in its national poll. Carrollton went from No. 11 to No. 1 in one week after beating Grayson. "},{"_id":"V57TAUUOY5AZJG35IU75RCSGJ4","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“Really what it comes down to is, have you played a tough enough schedule? Do you have enough quality wins?’” Poff said. “Because people say, ‘Oh, they’re undefeated, but they haven’t really played anybody,’ but you look at a Carrollton or Buford. If they finish undefeated, they’re playing in that Class 6A Georgia bracket, that’s going to go a long way.” "},{"_id":"HA4JTA367JFEXBYU6Q2OGKXCHU","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"A Georgia team has never won the MaxPreps national title."},{"level":2,"_id":"E2SJMLLMLRDLVA6752OTI7KQRM","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"header","content":"High School Football America: The long shot"},{"_id":"MWI4N7KP35FP7K55PYGSPEBWCU","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"<b>Rankings: Buford 8, Carrollton 14 </b>"},{"_id":"LTFZKE5JOFAGDLTFOT4RV2VV44","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Buford and Carrollton’s chances at finishing No. 1 in High School Football America’s rankings are certainly slimmer than other polls. But HSFA co-owner Jeff Fisher didn’t rule out the possibility entirely. "},{"_id":"MQLAW4OPCRAKRLWYGIVZHB6I3I","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"That’s because HSFA’s poll is formed entirely by a computer. It’s the same algorithm that awarded one of Georgia high school football’s most recent national championships to Colquitt County in 2015. "},{"_id":"S7PI3XY4IRH73OEMA6MQHJLKV4","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"The lack of human opinion in the poll could work in Buford or Carrollton’s favor, especially if either team wins by several scores. The algorithm also considers the rigor of the GHSA Class 6A bracket, which ranks as the second-toughest bracket in the country this season. "},{"_id":"UI7NCII445CEDLTLP4CXBEK5A4","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Winning that Class 6A bracket would offer Buford or Carrollton a hefty boost in the final Top 300 rankings. "},{"_id":"VVD7WJAL3REWZO3ZYO36YLOVMQ","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Buford has a better shot at finishing No. 1, because it sits six spots ahead of Carrollton. But the Trojans have climbed the HSFA poll significantly throughout the season, working up from No. 96 to No. 14. "},{"_id":"5B7N2LXRCJBBDOMSU45AGERT7E","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[{"date":"2025-12-11T20:05:35.886Z","replies":[],"pos":61,"comment":" over","isNote":true,"type":"insert","user":"NANCY CLANTON","email":"Nancy.Clanton@coxinc.com"}],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Fisher said Carrollton’s wins over Grayson and North Gwinnett the last couple weeks helped the Trojans skyrocket. Buford started at No. 12 and has climbed four spots since the start of the season. "},{"_id":"QARRTORWE5ADZHSIQOWZ6L2A3E","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“Mathematically, I would say there’s definitely a shot at it, but it’s a very slim margin,” he said. "},{"_id":"Z5FMRJWPXRFHTM5IA6LWAFUYZ4","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Colquitt County (2015) is the only Georgia school to win the HSFA national title."},{"level":2,"_id":"OR4HKGULFZD2TOPGBH4STXXVJE","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"header","content":"SBLive: Looking for ‘thorough performance’"},{"_id":"PZQZVKLJCJB2NHOVLQVOXT6LCA","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"<b>Rankings: No. 2 Buford, No. 3 Carrollton </b>"},{"_id":"HOWDJATFF5CWJP4FGUUUBVNO6Q","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Buford and Carrollton have one game to prove they’re better than SBLive’s No. 1 team, St. Frances Academy. The national powerhouse is a private school that finished its season Wednesday with a 37-20 win over Corner Canyon (Utah) in the Overtime Nationals."},{"_id":"S47N6VGFTJCMZMGKXWWLQKZFKE","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"It was Saint Frances Academy’s first game since Nov. 1. The Panthers finished 9-1, with their only loss coming across the country at national blue blood Saint John Bosco."},{"_id":"MSUVXFTB2VCP7E5MNRM6TEUM6Y","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"SBLive writer Rene Ferran said Buford and Carrollton need to show his team why they are better than Saint Frances Academy, Southlake Carroll, Bishop Gorman and Edna Karr (Louisiana). "},{"_id":"6EAUZVI4AVETPBLA5C64BYRCHY","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“This will sound kind of corny, but (we’re looking for) a thorough with St. Frances.” "},{"_id":"LX3F4DKH5JA25I7DR5GNJRH25Y","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Though Ferran wishes he could watch the nation’s top four teams face off, he said the national championship will be awarded to the team that best passes “the eye test.” "},{"_id":"YLQDUBRKBVE4NAQFDFYLKCK2R4","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“If Southlake Carroll and Edna Karr do as expected and win their titles, Waters argued the punishments for that game were not as harsh and asked for “consistent” sanctions, according to the school release."},{"_id":"Z3IGAOWZRREM5B2ZW6CSF4RCS4","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[{"date":"2025-12-10T17:38:28.370Z","replies":[],"pos":83,"comment":" players","isNote":true,"type":"insert","user":"NANCY CLANTON","email":"Nancy.Clanton@coxinc.com"}],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"The GHSA also repealed 42 of the 44 suspensions for Brunswick players. The only two suspensions that stood were the two players ejected from the game on the night of the fight."},{"_id":"PDJ53WGNZBDJJE4PB3IM3CKMWQ","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“Brunswick High School will enforce the appropriate sanctions for every player identified as having engaged in fighting on the night of Friday, November 21, 2025,” the release said. “Students receiving sanctions will serve a one-game suspension and have already begun serving school discipline according to the Glynn County Code of Conduct.”"},{"_id":"B2DGEEMSZ5B4DPK6PL3RIFRAWE","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Brunswick will still pay a fine that is yet to be determined."},{"_id":"R4X7LDX7MBEOBK4RO3QBO7JME4","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Water is a member of the GHSA Board of Trustees, though he did not vote. The decision to reverse the sanctions was decided on an 11-1 vote."},{"_id":"KDY7XBON6VEKHH5RSLR4AWBC4I","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“There is absolutely no place for incidents of this nature in high school athletics, or in sports at any level,” Waters said in the release. “We deeply regret the incident that occurred at Glynn County Stadium. Moving forward, we are committed to taking meaningful steps with our football program and all athletic programs in Glynn County to reinforce the values of sportsmanship, discipline, responsibility, and respect. Our goal is to ensure a safe, positive environment for all student-athletes, coaches, officials, and spectators.”"},{"_id":"M3RVNQUGKFBVVECFK3ZI46LB7I","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"The decision comes one day after fourth-year Brunswick <a href=\"https://www.ajc.com/sports/2025/12/brunswick-football-coach-resigns-in-wake-of-gainesville-altercation/\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noreferrer\" title=\"https://www.ajc.com/sports/2025/12/brunswick-football-coach-resigns-in-wake-of-gainesville-altercation/\">coach Garrett Grady stepped down</a> from his position. Garrett led the Pirates to a 36-10 record and three region titles during his tenure. "},{"_id":"IBQFVEYFKREL7CWKX6EMTXZIME","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"While going to nine conference games is a win for fans, Georgia head coach Kirby Smart voiced his concern with the expanded SEC schedule after the Bulldogs beat Alabama to win this year’s SEC championship. "},{"_id":"SMFC5ISHQNDHROA5IHO3KUDAQI","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“Those two teams were beat up tonight. Fla. — The Falcons rallied from a double-digit deficit and overcame 19 penalties to pull out a 29-28 victory over the Bucs on Thursday night at Raymond James Stadium."},{"_id":"TKABO4TMCZAZRETE4OWMUHCGUQ","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Kicker Zane Gonzalez made a 43-yard field goal at the buzzer to finish off the rally, which included a big fourth-quarter interception by cornerback Dee Alford. "},{"_id":"L6QCSA342BEAVO5EDWPFS72TAQ","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“When I got out there, I’m big into breathing,” Gonzalez said. “I was trying to relax and calm my nerves.”"},{"_id":"A7QQ3XTTCZH7LE6PJGFH7V4VLU","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"The Falcons are 5-9 on the season. The Bucs, in a battle to earn their fifth consecutive NFC South title, fell to 7-7."},{"_id":"5FPBFPRJOVHUJHJ65MSI3X4CGQ","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“It’s amazing,” Falcons tight end Kyle Pitts said. “We’ve been having our ups and downs through the year. Obviously, it’s not fun when you’re eliminated early. But we’re resilient. The team that we have is tight knit. We fight for each other.” "},{"_id":"ES53MZXANVE7PHXU2CO73JUKGM","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Quarterback Kirk Cousins leaned on Pitts, who had 11 catches for 166 yards and three touchdowns. Running back Bijan Robinson had 18 rushes for 93 yards, a touchdown and a fumble. He caught eight passes for 82 yards. "},{"_id":"HHKP226WIJCZZGWCFUDRDBON7I","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“I love the great state of Florida, yes I do,” said Pitts, who played at Florida and has tormented the Bucs in the past."},{"_id":"3S2ZL7YYZNBNZIWLX7SZA5ADXM","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"The Falcons had dropped seven of their previous eight games and were eliminated from the playoffs last week. "},{"_id":"NO7HQYRE7ZFYJN24RUNKERZELY","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“We fought as a team,” Falcons coach Raheem Morris said. “I couldn’t be more proud of how the guys stayed resilient throughout the course of the game. They found a way to win tonight.” "},{"_id":"XB4L6MWSB5BQ3NGQ3TITNLZJFI","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Cousins completed 30 of 44 passes for 373 yards and three touchdowns. He finished with 117 passer rating, his highest this season."},{"_id":"D4V33NHMHZBMBP4AC6EVVGQJFM","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“Just proud of my teammates, my coaches and the effort that everybody put forth to make this happen,” Cousins said. “Proud of our resiliency to be down 14 and fight back.”"},{"_id":"TVV66KWAKBDGNCE3I2SOUNEP24","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"On the game winning drive, the Falcons, because of penalties face a third-and-28 from Atlanta’s 29. Cousins found Pitts for a 14-yard gain. "},{"_id":"ECP2QFNCTFHUJF2QM37WE4T2TE","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"On fourth-and-14 and the game on the line with 49 seconds left, Cousin got the ball out to wide receiver David Sills V for a 21-yard gain to reach Tampa Bay’s 36. "},{"_id":"OBEQH2KPX5FCXC5IYILQK3VN7U","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"The Bucs jumped offsides and Darnell Mooney caught a pass for 6 yards to move the ball down to the Bucs’ 25 with 24 seconds left. "},{"_id":"L7WKNNNRGFFNXCZXJQLVXM7DFM","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Robinson ran for no gain to the left hash mark and then the Falcons spiked the ball with :05 seconds left. Gonzalez came on and won the game."},{"_id":"GD6XRLV4OREVXEZ7SQUAJBPNAM","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“I was happy that we were able to get on that side of the field and have the opportunity,” Gonzalez said. “Once we got the turnover, I had a bad kickoff earlier in the game. It was kind of a redemption. Once we got the ball, I was just praying that I could get the chance to get out there.” "},{"_id":"2F4ZDZ73AZGLLMPSSC2AN7C4PQ","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"After a penalty-filled and sloppily played first half, the Falcons somehow managed to hold a 14-13 lead over the Bucs."},{"_id":"GZMZVRE2ZBFC5OVXOW7752X3P4","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Pitts caught two touchdown passes in the half as the Falcons had to overcome 11 penalties for 70 yards. One penalty was declined."},{"_id":"B7DWQODMLFDYLDZ26VF6LTQQCI","additional_properties":{"nofollow":false,"selectedStory":false,"sponsored":false,"openInNewTab":true},"type":"interstitial_link","content":"Five takeaways from Falcons’ thrilling victory Thursday at Tampa Bay","url":"https://www.ajc.com/sports/2025/12/five-takeaways-from-falcons-thrilling-victory-thursday-at-tampa-bay/"},{"_id":"CKOZS4YRTNCERDH4KL3KRLDT4M","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Both teams punted on their first possessions, and the Falcons had the Bucs stopped on their second possession with a sack on third down by linebacker Kaden Elliss. But cornerback A.J. Terrell was called for defensive holding to keep the drive alive."},{"_id":"XFSAO7LWO5H7PC7XNI6G36QCHM","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"A few plays later, Terrell was called for an illegal contact penalty, but the Bucs picked up the third-and-15 on a 23-yard pass to wide receiver Emeka Egbuka. The Bucs scored on a 1-yard touchdown run by running back Sean Tucker to cap the 11-play, 83-yard drive that took 4:44 off the clock. "},{"_id":"NZ4ZLT5BEZAFVAHDMMW6ULBHI4","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"The Falcons answered with a 26-yard pass to Pitts to start their next drive. The drive stalled, and the Falcons made a field goal on fourth-and-4, but the Bucs jumped offside to give them a first down. Cousins found Pitts for an 8-yard touchdown pass to tie the score at 7-7."},{"_id":"5FR4YH6ELZCHFIURDFMRV246NY","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"After an exchange of punts, Bucs kicker Chase McLaughlin made a 49-yard field goal to put the Bucs up 10-7 with 2:10 left in the second quarter."},{"_id":"7AFG5XX35JEUFOKC26DFXP3ZPY","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Cousins directed the Falcons down the field in four plays, connecting with Pitts on plays of 36 yards and a 17-yard touchdown pass to cap the four-play, 64-yard drive. The Falcons led 14-10 with 38 seconds left. "},{"_id":"3GSICRULO5GTBC6TTW2K6M4TTI","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"With cornerback Mike Hughes out with an ankle injury, the Bucs exploited their matchup with Mike Evans guarded by rookie Cobee Bryant to get into field-goal range. McLaughlin made a 52-yard field goal at the buzzer. "},{"_id":"EXYKUGHQT5DH3BUIXEQCZUAOBY","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"The Falcons had the ball to open the third quarter, but were forced to punt."},{"_id":"RMRYIGDYLBE7JNLSR6UAKWGBBU","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"The Bucs went back down the field with another big play to Evans. Baker Mayfield capped a nine-play, 90-yard drive with 6-yard touchdown pass to tight end Devin Culp to put the Bucs up 20-14 with 6:22 to play in third quarter. Braves were aggressive in their pursuit of outfielder Mike Yastrzemski, so much to the point the player was flattered by their urgency to complete a deal. And in joining the Braves, he saw certainty."},{"_id":"5FNTAOWNTZHYVITNAGIKU2GFN4","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“The No. 1 thing is the history of the organization and trying to win,” Yastrzemski said when asked what separated the Braves from his other suitors. “As I’ve gone through my career — not saying I hope it’s close to anywhere near done — but you only have so many chances to win. That was the first thing that drew me here, the strong commitment to trying to win a championship.”"},{"_id":"KIQ4Y57P7NCJXD26P5SOMGPMHA","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Yastrzemski, 35, signed a two-year, $23 million deal that includes a $7 million club option ($4 million buyout) Wednesday. It was a healthy contract for a player who will serve a part-time role. The veteran is much more effective against righties than lefties, and his outfield versatility — he can play all three spots — widens the Braves’ lineup options. The team intends to deploy a rotating designated hitter, so Yastrzemski will make it easier to get their primary outfielders — Jurickson Profar, Michael Harris II and Ronald Acuña Jr. — off their feet, too."},{"_id":"52XOKHVXUVCULFRLSBXW4JQRN4","additional_properties":{"nofollow":false,"selectedStory":false,"sponsored":false,"openInNewTab":true},"type":"interstitial_link","content":"Braves sign outfielder Mike Yastrzemski","url":"https://www.ajc.com/sports/2025/12/braves-sign-outfielder-mike-yastrzemski/"},{"_id":"H3O7U2Q4MFB3TD6MHKRPTINR4U","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"When the Braves tried to explain their idea for Yastrzemski’s role, he said he politely cut them off: “Look, I don’t care. I want to be part of an organization that wins. And with them showing the commitment to me to give me the two-year guaranteed deal, that gives me the ability to 100% buy-in and be the best teammate I can, and try to find any given way to help them out. "},{"_id":"7NNJ6GY62VFATEMD4CSE7F7JRM","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“What I’d been told is there’d be some at-bats in left (field), the DH being flexible, and there are days when I could play right, give Ronnie a DH day if he needs it. If Mike needs rest, I can spend a day in center. I’m willing to play anywhere they need me in any capacity.”"},{"_id":"MVKKGNWSX5EOXJ3KSEINE6LIFU","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Yastrzemski spent last season split between the Giants and Royals, hitting .233 with 17 homers and 46 RBIs. His 2.8 bWAR was the best of his career. He thrived with Kansas City, who was the Braves’ greatest competition for his services in free agency."},{"_id":"5V7Q4LVFEFC6NHRLA2XILJVFVI","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"This is a return to the South for Yastrzemski, who played for Vanderbilt in Nashville. He said it’s “huge” to be closer to family and friends down here. Yastrzemski said he has always admired the Braves from afar. His father, Michael, played in the Braves’ minor-league system in the mid-1980s."},{"_id":"F7LPKH4ZWFAW5OHGDQXII3NPKQ","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“Any time the Braves came through Fenway (Park in Boston), we’d always say hi to (former manager) Bobby Cox because he knew (my dad),” Yastrzemski said. “So I have these long-term memories of rooting for the Braves from afar. … The Red Sox were my team, but I always followed the Braves as my National League team. It was always those two teams. I was a huge Chipper (Jones) fan. I grew up idolizing Andruw Jones playing center field. Those were the type of plays I dreamed of making one day. "},{"_id":"TD7QEF3SJNDGXDP24NEJMWROKQ","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“So the appeal of the history is a big thing for me. I know they have a great staff, great ownership and an unbelievable front office, but they also have the history of great players that I know are still around and willing to step in and help out and bring in some great information. Those are once-in-a-lifetime opportunities.”"}],"subheadlines":{"basic":"‘I’m willing to play anywhere they need me in any capacity,’ he says."},"description":{"basic":"“The No. 1 thing is the history of the organization and trying to win,” Yastrzemski said when asked what separated the Braves from his other suitors. Braves signed reliever Robert Suarez on Thursday, further bolstering a bullpen that already includes one of the game’s best closers in Raisel Iglesias."},{"_id":"2YDPWX5V7FCL5DTXWTXGX3WGYM","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Suarez, 34, signed a three-year, $45 million contract. The right-hander will earn $13 million this season and $16 million in the next two seasons. Suarez can be a setup man for Iglesias, and he’s positioned to assume closer duties in 2027 should the Braves not re-sign their incumbent closer, who’s on a one-year, $16 million deal."},{"_id":"GKJTE2LALZE6HAH7LCFFKOICRU","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“I’m just really excited to join this club; I feel like as far as I can remember, they’ve been competitive,” Suarez said via team interpreter Franco Garcia. “I’ve really only ever heard good things about this clubhouse and this team, so I’m just excited to become a member of it.”"},{"_id":"DQFOWU6LEND3PMCVMKLBGM7CCU","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Suarez earned his second consecutive All-Star nod in 2025, posting a 2.97 ERA in 70 appearances with the Padres. Suarez owned a 2.91 ERA over his four-year career, entirely with San Diego. He also has a 2.45 ERA in 12 postseason appearances (14⅔ innings)."},{"_id":"HVTQ5VCPJBEMLK5UTQFJ3RTD4U","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"He was among the more popular free agents this winter, as numerous teams — including the Mets — had interest in adding Suarez to their bullpen. Suarez didn’t delve into negotiations with other clubs, but he reiterated everything he’d heard about the Braves helped them separate from other suitors. He was encouraged in hearing how the Braves treat their players and families, and by what he was told about Atlanta itself. His fellow Venezuelan countryman Ronald Acuña Jr. and former teammate Jurickson Profar also raved about the organization, he said."},{"_id":"OJYBFAVA4VACFPOJGCIUTZWSRE","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Suarez said he was OK with being a setup man for Iglesias and that was never deterring: “I’m willing to contribute in whatever which way and add my little grain of sand to help the team win in any way. I’m happy to do whatever the team needs.”"},{"_id":"25VLKKJ3DFFL3DAT5TIJ2SOD4E","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"The Braves have aggressively pursued pitching reinforcements this winter. They reportedly were involved with All-Star closer Edwin Diaz before he joined the Dodgers. His signing would have also required a significant financial commitment. They’d been linked with Suarez, whose signing acquisition continued president of baseball operations Alex Anthopoulos’ long-standing emphasis on investing in his bullpen."},{"_id":"57YHWK2M2RC53KA4FTBJ34M37U","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"While the Braves will probably still add at least one more reliever, their heavy lifting in the bullpen has probably concluded. “We fortified the back end, and I’m looking forward to talking more in depth with Iglesias,” Suarez said. “I think we’re going to have a really nice relationship and we’re going to get along great.”"},{"_id":"YPURIT4PKRHC5P4FI5GBG3MIIA","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Suarez is the team’s second significant signing in as many days. It added outfielder Mike Yastrzemski on a two-year, $23 million deal (with a club option) Wednesday. The Braves have spent $38 million on their 2026 payroll in signing Iglesias, Yastrzemski and Suarez."},{"_id":"MEPR7YVMVFADPD56XFP436OMFM","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Yastrzemski, who competed against Suarez in the National League West while with the Giants, spoke glowingly of his new teammate."},{"_id":"RDYRTAJJNFEAHLU5O3X7573HHU","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“An absolute stud,” Yastrzemski said of Suarez. “That was never a fun time when I saw him running in from the bullpen. It was one of those like, ‘All right, I have to grind here to find a way to put together a decent at-bat.’ You never expect to do anything great off of him. He strikes fear into other hitters. "},{"_id":"2IL6GKHPNJGORDEVQG7DULF7NI","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“I think it’s another sign of commitment from the Braves that they’re doing exactly what they should be doing to put together as competitive a team as possible. He was one of the best arms out there that was available in the back end of the bullpen. I haven’t gotten to meet him or know him personally yet, but haven’t heard a bad thing about him through the grapevine, which is some of the most important stuff. I’ve heard all good things about him.”"}],"subheadlines":{"basic":"Atlanta signs the former Padres closer to a three-year, $45 million contract."},"description":{"basic":"The Atlanta Braves signed reliever Robert Suarez to a three-year, $45 million contract Thursday.
