and Carrollton, who boast a combined 21 state titles, both have a chance to claim their first national championship when they clash in the Class 6A final on Tuesday. "},{"_id":"J5FHYKXOAVC57GHZUIK6NSDMZQ","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"The Wolves and Trojans both enter the game at 14-0 with impressive wins along the way. Buford opened the season with four straight wins over No. 3 Milton, No. 2 Benedictine, No. 6 Roswell and No. 4 Douglas County before kicking off region play. Carrollton beat No. 3 Gainesville, No. 6 Douglas County, No. 10 Harrison, No. 1 Grayson and No. 8 North Gwinnett throughout the season. "},{"_id":"PSXLRCQ34ZHTDIRGCWVIZS3BHM","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Buford has won 14 state titles, three of which came under seventh-year coach Bryant Appling. The Wolves have also won five region championships since Appling took over. "},{"_id":"YBYXTLQIDNGNPGYBWB77CWJ7BU","additional_properties":{"nofollow":false,"selectedStory":false,"sponsored":false,"openInNewTab":true},"type":"interstitial_link","content":"Maxwell AAAAA semifinal predictions: Look for two close battles to advance to the championship","url":"https://www.ajc.com/sports/2025/12/maxwell-aaaaa-semifinal-predictions-look-for-two-close-battles-to-advance-to-the-championship/"},{"_id":"HYKMC6NVV5BVZE35WVABFHDQCM","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Buford also boasts one of the most talented rosters in the country, headlined by AJC Super 11 selection Tyriq Green. The future University of Georgia safety leads a ferocious defense with Texas A&amp;M defensive lineman signee Bryce Perry-Wright and Ohio State edge signee Dre Quinn. Three-star junior quarterback Dayton Raiola leads an offense stacked with future Power 4 players. "},{"_id":"NSCKA3JDC5BBTM2XLTGMWEQ4PI","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Carrollton has won seven titles, though its last came in 1998. The Trojans have made the state championship three of the past four years and beat Buford 30-17 last season to get there. Carrollton has won four consecutive region championships under fifth-year coach Joey King. "},{"_id":"LFL3XPJ56RBQLK4UZW22V5SOZM","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Two UGA signees headline Carrollton’s offense: 4-star receiver Ryan Mosley and 3-star offensive lineman Zykie Helton. Four-star Ole Miss cornerback signee Dorian Barney leads a defense full of future FBS players."},{"_id":"3SQASU7IOJESBHNLSLENQLJBKY","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Both teams have won with enough dominance to be in contention for national championships from several media polls. Although there is no single national championship game in high school football, outlets that release rankings all season name the No. 1 team at the end of the season their “national champion.”"},{"_id":"R7PKEHXQQFGYRNFGISINBQJ3W4","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Many outlets rank Buford and Carrollton high enough that the winner of the Class 6A state championship could finish the season at No. 1, winning their first national championship."},{"_id":"YQ3F3ENFMZAJNPDRBG6NWYNMH4","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[{"date":"2025-12-11T19:49:56.982Z","replies":[],"pos":74,"comment":" many polls like","isNote":true,"type":"insert","user":"NANCY CLANTON","email":"Nancy.Clanton@coxinc.com"}],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Last season, Mater Dei (California) was named the national championship by USA Today, High School Football America, SBLive, MaxPreps and other polls. The Monarchs went 13-0 with wins over national powerhouses like Bishop Gorman (Nevada), Santa Margarita (California), Saint Frances Academy (Maryland), Saint John Bosco (California) and De La Salle (California)."},{"_id":"QVPVCAK74RGXHLGCOLWQU33RLU","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Georgia’s 2024 Class 5A champion, Milton, did win <a href=\"https://www.georgiahighschoolfootballdaily.com/main-news/milton-named-high-school-football-america-public-school-national-champion#:~:text=Milton%20named%20High%20School%20Football,Dei%20of%20Orange%20County%2C%20Calif.\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"\" title=\"https://www.georgiahighschoolfootballdaily.com/main-news/milton-named-high-school-football-america-public-school-national-champion#:~:text=Milton%20named%20High%20School%20Football,Dei%20of%20Orange%20County%2C%20Calif.\">High School Football America’s public school national title</a>. Other recent Georgia national champions include 2015 Colquitt County (HSFA), 2011 Calhoun (MaxPreps Small School) and 2002 Parkview (USAHSF)."},{"_id":"LAA2X4LN4FHZJJINDQ5PMKL6MM","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[{"date":"2025-12-11T19:51:00.784Z","replies":[],"pos":98,"comment":" TODAY","isNote":true,"type":"insert","user":"NANCY CLANTON","email":"Nancy.Clanton@coxinc.com"}],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Georgia has not had a consensus No. 1 since 1991, when LaGrange was named national champion by USA Today."},{"_id":"FEUF2XVGZ5HTRAM5ZVXSDGCPGM","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Final top 25 polls won’t release until Texas finishes its playoffs Dec. 20. Most polls will announce a national champion in the following couple of days."},{"_id":"A4ODMIQWU5EK5LWZN3C4YOUIXE","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Contributors from USA Today, MaxPreps, High School Football America and SBLive all explained how Buford or Carrollton can win a national championship Tuesday. "},{"_id":"SYEHK5TDRFEGRDEF57MJSRI5EM","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"USA Today is the longest-running active poll at 43 years. MaxPreps’ poll started in 2005, High School Football America started in 2012 and SBLive started in 2020."},{"level":2,"_id":"2OGSW3ZCUVFPNC33OESOJLGWI4","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"header","content":"USA Today: ‘Consistency is always key’"},{"_id":"QQ6UR5GDRREA3NEGEE5MBMDPBU","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"<b>Rankings: No. 1 Buford, No. 2 Carrollton </b>"},{"_id":"YPFIOEQD2ZALNAKWGVRNIYLGFA","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Tuesday night’s game in Mercedes-Benz Stadium is a true national championship in the eyes of USA Today’s poll, which ranks Buford and Carrollton at No. 1 and No. 2, respectively. "},{"_id":"OZPLOMER4ZGCLJ7AEVF5ENMTKM","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[{"date":"2025-12-11T19:56:13.005Z","replies":[],"pos":65,"comment":" throughout the season","isNote":true,"type":"insert","user":"NANCY CLANTON","email":"Nancy.Clanton@coxinc.com"}],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Buford started the season in the top 10 and slowly made up ground. Carrollton started at No. 24 and had moved up only to No. 11 by late November. "},{"_id":"3IX5RBXZZZEWTKWULMNUZ5PP4M","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[{"date":"2025-12-11T19:56:39.040Z","replies":[],"pos":67,"comment":" from there","isNote":true,"type":"insert","user":"NANCY CLANTON","email":"Nancy.Clanton@coxinc.com"}],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Then the Trojans hammered Grayson 34-14, and they moved up to No. 4. "},{"_id":"WNYQTHQFIFFT3ARJBMORNOXY3M","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“With Buford and Carrollton, it’s like, these guys are clearly a class above others when it comes to being able to control the competition,” USA Today senior content strategist Rick Suter said. "},{"_id":"O6JWENZBK5FYRHF3T4BBN5VEQE","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[{"date":"2025-12-11T19:58:03.526Z","replies":[],"pos":55,"comment":" like","isNote":true,"type":"insert","user":"NANCY CLANTON","email":"Nancy.Clanton@coxinc.com"},{"date":"2025-12-11T19:58:28.812Z","replies":[],"pos":83,"comment":" (California)","isNote":true,"type":"insert","user":"NANCY CLANTON","email":"Nancy.Clanton@coxinc.com"},{"date":"2025-12-11T19:58:45.647Z","replies":[],"pos":104,"comment":" (Maryland)","isNote":true,"type":"insert","user":"NANCY CLANTON","email":"Nancy.Clanton@coxinc.com"},{"date":"2025-12-11T19:58:50.831Z","replies":[],"pos":122,"comment":" (Nevada)","isNote":true,"type":"insert","user":"NANCY CLANTON","email":"Nancy.Clanton@coxinc.com"}],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Unexpected losses from annual national title contenders Mater Dei, Saint John Bosco, St. Frances Academy and Bishop Gorman opened the door for the undefeated Georgia teams. "},{"_id":"CEA2UKZ3G5AIFCZJBR7XGHPFIU","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“Consistency is always key to me,” Suter said. “When you’re looking at being able to have that sort of dominance week in and week out, showing that sort of growth. Obviously, they’ve got a really talented roster with both of those schools. "},{"_id":"5J3CKCPNCRFHJHAJDUWSGCKGSY","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“Being able to show that kind of consistency that they did over those teams is what had us moving them forward.” "},{"_id":"WW46N7FD6ZEADHNJN2CJZWV7ZU","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Suter doesn’t decide the rankings on his own, but he knows exactly where his national champion vote will go after Tuesday night. "},{"_id":"GBWODQYUPFCVPGKA2LY6ZKFEWE","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“The winner of that game, to me, is the national champion,” Suter said. “From the body of work, showing the consistency … I don’t see any surprises coming.” "},{"_id":"BRAXH2MJKBGHPFLV5YBQUFL754","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"LaGrange (1991) and Valdosta (1986, 1984) are the only Georgia schools to win USA Today’s national title."},{"level":2,"_id":"OIRKSA2BJVFIBNLK2VAEGASQQE","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"header","content":"MaxPreps: Zeroing in on quality wins"},{"_id":"MA3JHKMPIRD4FELFTNTL7YR3VA","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"<b>Rankings: No. 1 Carrollton No. 6 Buford </b>"},{"_id":"KEHDLAOESZAUZCO3SILO7D3NHA","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"A Carrollton win would likely make the Trojans the MaxPreps national champion. Buford does sit behind several other national title contenders, but the Wolves can certainly make their case to finish at No. 1 on Tuesday night. "},{"_id":"HCXJ2RPPVVBXREYVVXIKFDBD5Q","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"National football editor Zachary Poff wants to see Carrollton and Buford differentiate themselves from one other undefeated contender, No. 3-ranked Southlake Carroll (Texas). Southlake Carroll is 14-0 and will face No. 64-ranked DeSoto in the UIL Class 6A Division 2 semifinals Saturday. "},{"_id":"FMKJEKCXB5GOHOMSLA6XN4ZUJ4","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Southlake Carroll would advance to face either Vandergrift or King in the state championship. Vandergrift is ranked No. 95 nationally, and King is unranked. "},{"_id":"7UFUYZ3LL5E5NG4WHUVFHOFPWE","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"So, a Buford win over the poll’s top-ranked team could be plenty strong enough to claim the No. 1 spot. But Poff said the way Buford would potentially beat Carrollton also matters. "},{"_id":"STZC4OAKJRB6JJEFIFETKGLIG4","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“If Buford absolutely dominates Carrollton, that’s going to go a long way,” Poff said. “If Buford wins a close game, and it’s kind of Carrollton beating themselves a little bit, that might open the door a little more. It all depends on watching the games and how they play out.” "},{"_id":"K4ESJ2GMDFET3C7VMELIGVN6XA","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"MaxPreps has already shown it has no issue bumping a team up several spots in its national poll. Carrollton went from No. 11 to No. 1 in one week after beating Grayson. "},{"_id":"V57TAUUOY5AZJG35IU75RCSGJ4","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“Really what it comes down to is, have you played a tough enough schedule? Do you have enough quality wins?’” Poff said. “Because people say, ‘Oh, they’re undefeated, but they haven’t really played anybody,’ but you look at a Carrollton or Buford. If they finish undefeated, they’re playing in that Class 6A Georgia bracket, that’s going to go a long way.” "},{"_id":"HA4JTA367JFEXBYU6Q2OGKXCHU","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"A Georgia team has never won the MaxPreps national title."},{"level":2,"_id":"E2SJMLLMLRDLVA6752OTI7KQRM","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"header","content":"High School Football America: The long shot"},{"_id":"MWI4N7KP35FP7K55PYGSPEBWCU","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"<b>Rankings: Buford 8, Carrollton 14 </b>"},{"_id":"LTFZKE5JOFAGDLTFOT4RV2VV44","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Buford and Carrollton’s chances at finishing No. 1 in High School Football America’s rankings are certainly slimmer than other polls. But HSFA co-owner Jeff Fisher didn’t rule out the possibility entirely. "},{"_id":"MQLAW4OPCRAKRLWYGIVZHB6I3I","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"That’s because HSFA’s poll is formed entirely by a computer. It’s the same algorithm that awarded one of Georgia high school football’s most recent national championships to Colquitt County in 2015. "},{"_id":"S7PI3XY4IRH73OEMA6MQHJLKV4","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"The lack of human opinion in the poll could work in Buford or Carrollton’s favor, especially if either team wins by several scores. The algorithm also considers the rigor of the GHSA Class 6A bracket, which ranks as the second-toughest bracket in the country this season. "},{"_id":"UI7NCII445CEDLTLP4CXBEK5A4","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Winning that Class 6A bracket would offer Buford or Carrollton a hefty boost in the final Top 300 rankings. "},{"_id":"VVD7WJAL3REWZO3ZYO36YLOVMQ","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Buford has a better shot at finishing No. 1, because it sits six spots ahead of Carrollton. But the Trojans have climbed the HSFA poll significantly throughout the season, working up from No. 96 to No. 14. "},{"_id":"5B7N2LXRCJBBDOMSU45AGERT7E","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[{"date":"2025-12-11T20:05:35.886Z","replies":[],"pos":61,"comment":" over","isNote":true,"type":"insert","user":"NANCY CLANTON","email":"Nancy.Clanton@coxinc.com"}],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Fisher said Carrollton’s wins over Grayson and North Gwinnett the last couple weeks helped the Trojans skyrocket. Buford started at No. 12 and has climbed four spots since the start of the season. "},{"_id":"QARRTORWE5ADZHSIQOWZ6L2A3E","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“Mathematically, I would say there’s definitely a shot at it, but it’s a very slim margin,” he said. "},{"_id":"Z5FMRJWPXRFHTM5IA6LWAFUYZ4","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Colquitt County (2015) is the only Georgia school to win the HSFA national title."},{"level":2,"_id":"OR4HKGULFZD2TOPGBH4STXXVJE","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"header","content":"SBLive: Looking for ‘thorough performance’"},{"_id":"PZQZVKLJCJB2NHOVLQVOXT6LCA","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"<b>Rankings: No. 2 Buford, No. 3 Carrollton </b>"},{"_id":"HOWDJATFF5CWJP4FGUUUBVNO6Q","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Buford and Carrollton have one game to prove they’re better than SBLive’s No. 1 team, St. Frances Academy. The national powerhouse is a private school that finished its season Wednesday with a 37-20 win over Corner Canyon (Utah) in the Overtime Nationals."},{"_id":"S47N6VGFTJCMZMGKXWWLQKZFKE","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"It was Saint Frances Academy’s first game since Nov. 1. The Panthers finished 9-1, with their only loss coming across the country at national blue blood Saint John Bosco."},{"_id":"MSUVXFTB2VCP7E5MNRM6TEUM6Y","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"SBLive writer Rene Ferran said Buford and Carrollton need to show his team why they are better than Saint Frances Academy, Southlake Carroll, Bishop Gorman and Edna Karr (Louisiana). "},{"_id":"6EAUZVI4AVETPBLA5C64BYRCHY","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“This will sound kind of corny, but (we’re looking for) a thorough performance,” Ferran said. “A fluke win might probably would not move the needle as much, but a thorough performance by whichever team wins would certainly be enough to put the winner in that matchup with St. Frances.” "},{"_id":"LX3F4DKH5JA25I7DR5GNJRH25Y","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Though Ferran wishes he could watch the nation’s top four teams face off, he said the national championship will be awarded to the team that best passes “the eye test.” "},{"_id":"YLQDUBRKBVE4NAQFDFYLKCK2R4","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“If Southlake Carroll and Edna Karr do as expected and win their titles, wouldn’t it be fun to have a four-team playoff with those two, the Buford-Carrollton winner and St. Frances?” Ferran asked. “Not going to happen, so we’ve just got to go by our gut feeling and then let the debate begin.”"},{"_id":"GAYS3TKXDJEDVG7MMC7S33HGTY","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"A Georgia team has never won the SBLive national Jack worked for the AJC and its UGA-focused brand, DawgNation, throughout his four years studying journalism and sports media at Georgia State University and the University of Georgia. He's now focused on telling stories about Georgia communities and homegrown athletes through AJC Varsity's high school sports coverage. Jack has covered high school, college and professional sports over the past four years for the AJC. Before that, he held similar roles in two years working for the Gwinnett Daily Post. "},{"_id":"3AWPSJRLHRAOXM2YD5EHKHNOYY","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"This time last year, <a href=\"https://www.ajc.com/sports/2025/12/gunner-stocktons-growth-includes-different-mindset-since-last-sec-title-game/\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"\" title=\"https://www.ajc.com/sports/2025/12/gunner-stocktons-growth-includes-different-mindset-since-last-sec-title-game/\">Stockton was fresh off leading Georgia to a come-from-behind win over the Texas Longhorns in the SEC championship game.</a> He had come off the bench to relieve an injured Carson Beck. He was in the midst of preparing for his first career start, which would end up coming against Notre Dame in the College Football Playoff quarterfinals. "},{"_id":"HM7BZDUXTRAGNBW7LYFLAKMTFM","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"<a href=\"https://www.ajc.com/sports/2025/12/georgia-lands-no-3-seed-in-college-football-playoff-earns-first-round-bye/\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"\" title=\"https://www.ajc.com/sports/2025/12/georgia-lands-no-3-seed-in-college-football-playoff-earns-first-round-bye/\">Entering this year’s College Football Playoff</a>, Stockton is the only quarterback in the 12-team field who has started a CFP game. "},{"_id":"2LSYMAMNZ5BVJPZKS7TWCK452E","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“I think it was huge for him,” Georgia coach Kirby Smart said of Stockton. “I think it was really huge for the game, you know, at Tennessee, the game at home. I mean, all the games he played this year, he created value through those experiences. Even the second half of the SEC championship (game), man. I mean, he played against — number one, those were huge moments. Those were huge atmospheres.”"},{"_id":"WNGV75U4D5GM7NZD2EWYV4WMWU","additional_properties":{"nofollow":false,"selectedStory":false,"sponsored":false,"openInNewTab":true},"type":"interstitial_link","content":"What Georgia football will be looking to add in the transfer portal","url":"https://www.ajc.com/sports/2025/12/what-georgia-football-will-be-looking-to-add-in-the-transfer-portal/"},{"_id":"GPIJTG3BZZDJ5IPC4RAIBZI6VU","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Stockton did not win in his CFP debut, but he hardly was the main culprit in a 23-10 loss to Notre Dame. Stockton completed 20 of his 32 pass attempts for 234 yards and a touchdown. He did have a costly fumble just before halftime. "},{"_id":"2KCQUC7HURBONBBPHAKP43VPSE","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"That experience showed Stockton could do the job for Georgia. In his first road start for the Bulldogs this season, he passed for 304 yards and two touchdowns while rushing for another in a 44-41 overtime win against Tennessee. "},{"_id":"PBGAA7BEB5DPBC4X2RMEPWT4DA","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"From there, questions about Stockton’s ability to lead the Georgia offense dissipated. He accounted for five touchdowns each in home wins over ranked Ole Miss and Texas teams. "},{"_id":"CX5B6LP2WZHWFIYLLTJW7LNPYQ","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[{"date":"2025-12-11T15:31:57.302Z","replies":[],"pos":123,"comment":"rushing ","isNote":true,"type":"insert","user":"NANCY CLANTON","email":"Nancy.Clanton@coxinc.com"}],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"In this year’s SEC championship game against Alabama, Stockton threw for three touchdowns while also picking up some tough yards on 13 rushing attempts. "},{"_id":"RMUBXD7EZFCVZM5Y34TN6QXZV4","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Mathis took over the job in 2024 after being an assistant coach at private high schools Fellowship Christian and Blessed Trinity."},{"_id":"OVVT4MTCQZGUBIYRVF24WWVMSA","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"The Tigers went 4-16 in the two seasons under Mathis."},{"_id":"JYZTXZNBVNDR5NWKVF6SD2XEFA","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Mathis, who played high school football at for Redan High School, was a 1994 Pro Bowl selection when he was with the Atlanta Falcons. He was a sixth round NFL Draft pick out of New Mexico in 1990."},{"_id":"NT65UHO6PFFVVAWVLXGVHGHC64","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Mathis played 13 years in the NFL with the Jets (1990-93), Falcons (1994-2001) and Steelers (2002)."},{"_id":"JGOOTBCUJRCAZBCDGUD3ZDVBTQ","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"In <a href=\"https://morehouseathletics.com/news/2025/12/10/Morehouse_Announces_Change_In_Football_Leadership.aspx\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"\" title=\"https://morehouseathletics.com/news/2025/12/10/Morehouse_Announces_Change_In_Football_Leadership.aspx\">a release posted to Morehouse’s website</a>, athletic director Harold Ellis said “the moves are part of a broader effort to shape a bright and promising future for Morehouse Athletics.”"},{"_id":"CH3QEV536NCQDGLPQAHOMUGASA","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Offensive line coach Bob Whitfield, who was a Falcons teammate of Mathis’ and fellow Pro Bowl selection (1998), was also let go. Dinner","height":683,"image_type":"photograph","resized_obj":{"src":"https://www.ajc.com/resizer/v2/I2ABFWFYUFEDBGA75ZACRKQ3W4.jpg?auth=21e47f37236d243b1810bf10a83c9263b00584e657577267cf91cbdf7fb03f88&width=1260&height=840&smart=true"}}},{"content_elements":[{"_id":"ZC6VRG4H65DEPEDKZZSGCNH7RQ","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"ORLANDO, Fla. — The Braves have almost an entirely new coaching staff under manager Walt Weiss, a significant change after so many fruitful years of continuity."},{"_id":"JOKIUKH5VJBF5GC4ZIIA2EE7FI","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Weiss, who was promoted to succeed Brian Snitker following the club’s monthlong managerial search, spoke highly of his new-look group when asked about the individuals during his media availability at the winter meetings Tuesday."},{"_id":"W3CIUSARS5DEBDALPBXTWJ4GGE","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“Really good staff,” Weiss said. “Look, we had a really good staff, and I think it took some of these guys being available for those changes to happen, you know what I mean? I think everyone was very comfortable with the staff coming back. But there were some guys who became available that were really enticing, and we ended up getting them in the fold."},{"_id":"SHTV4M4HRBBZDFVVTYUI2VRFTY","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“But (president of baseball operations) Alex (Anthopoulos) and I talked a lot through all that. And it’s not easy putting together a staff. There’s a lot to think about. There’s a lot of boxes that have to be checked, and there’s several people that have to check all those boxes, when you’re looking at candidates."},{"_id":"DZYQ74WAJBEJDGMYPFBGFUUHSQ","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“The game is a lot more collaborative now, as we know. The days of the manager just naming his staff like 40 years ago, 30 years ago, those days are over. And rightfully so, because there’s so many people involved in the day-to-day now. The guys upstairs. Alex’s team. The game-planning stuff. So, the people we bring in have to fit the entire group.”"},{"_id":"DZPLUY6BINF7DC42ALTH2MJWVA","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Here’s what Weiss specifically said about several of the team’s new hires:"},{"_id":"EA3WOAMNAJHDFEHWK423VHEBDU","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"<b>On pitching coach Jeremy Hefner:</b>"},{"_id":"KBZ74NW7EJGX3IO55SGE42I7MM","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“He’s a sharp guy, man. I think the sweet spot in this game — we’re in the age of information and analytics and technology — is the guy or the guys that have feel, that have done it and understand the tech, understand the info, know how to use it. And Hefner’s the poster child for that. Really good feel. Pitched in the big leagues. He’s worked his way to the top. He’s dealt with — he’s been in one of the biggest markets, dealt with Hall of Famers, some pretty big personalities. And everybody raves about him. "},{"_id":"EACFGAWFFBFEBBJARFQE3SKYZQ","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“The thing that makes me feel good as a manager, every time we announced one of those coaching hires, my phone blew up from people who knew him, said, ‘Wow, you guys are putting together an unbelievable staff.’ So that’s very reassuring.”"},{"_id":"LXDD6B7I7RCPBFXTJ6FSMFT3TM","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"<b>On first base coach Antoan Richardson:</b>"},{"_id":"7BH4QLU54VBCZJE5L5KLYLSDIM","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“Once a guy like Antoan became available, things changed. I saw the impact he had with the Mets. I think they were 30th in sprint speed and fifth in stolen bases. That math doesn’t add up unless you have somebody that’s making a big difference, and that was Antoan. We feel like there’s some low-hanging fruit there with our club, not that we’re built to do that necessarily, especially once (outfielder) Ronald (Acuña Jr.) stopped running last year when he was playing a little more careful."},{"_id":"QPRQ2TAIVZCQLBFF7N6EKCIZNQ","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“But there’s some opportunity there to create some things on the offensive end. And I think Antoan is really going to help that. He’s passionate about it. I think he’s going to get our guys to be passionate about it. So that’s an exciting hire, and that’s an exciting part of our club that I think there’s some low-hanging fruit there.”"},{"_id":"UTST3KJGAJBBNAOR6AXOWDKDFU","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"<b>On bench coach Tony Mansolino:</b>"},{"_id":"4BBMCOSALRF55JBFZGASJ7UCKA","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“I’m really excited about Tony. He’s here (in Orlando) with me. Him and Hef came so we can spend some time together. I’ve got a little history with Tony, and I know his dad really well and coached with his dad, Doug Mansolino. Doug worked for us. He was like a senior adviser in player development for the Braves. Of course, I was on the other side of the field from him throughout my career a lot when he was a coach."},{"_id":"AQ7WTCMYTZCVDNSESMRW7VP4ZU","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[{"date":"2025-12-10T21:22:56.006-05:00","replies":[],"start":161,"end":165,"text":"Weiss recently had a birthday on Nov. 28, so now 62","user":"RON SIRMANS","email":"Ron.Sirmans@ajc.com"}]},"type":"text","content":"“I know Doug really well. I know Tony some. But Tony’s got a sharp mind. He’s impressive well beyond his years. I know he’s not a young guy (43). Compared to me (62) he is, but who isn’t? But he’s an impressive guy. And he sat in that seat (as an interim manager last season for Baltimore). I do think there’s some value there for a bench coach. It doesn’t mean everything, but it means something. And he’s got really good baseball eyes. He’s got a good baseball mind. We’ve had really good conversation already. So he’s going to work with our infielders, along with Tony Diaz."},{"_id":"NFERJAIIP5HGTJ4OEPQKQJJ56I","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“I was in a similar position, and this will probably help him. I was in that position the last couple of years where I was the bench coach and the infield guy. Now, in-game, you’ve got to delegate a little bit because the bench coach can’t be lining up the defense and all that at the same time, working with Snit."},{"_id":"FVWOYX2B5ZHVLEOHZT7CQYQ53Q","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“So, Tony Diaz will take care of the defensive alignment. That’s what (former third base coach Matt Tuiasosopo) did and what (former third base coach) Fredi González did while he was here while I was bench coaching in-game. It will help Tony that I sat in that exact seat that he’s going to.”"}],"source":{"system":"composer","name":"ajc","source_type":"staff"},"taxonomy":{"primary_site":{"path":"/sports/atlanta-braves","parent_id":"/sports","name":"Atlanta Jordan Do was honored as Gwinnett County’s best quarterback for the second consecutive season on Monday, adding to a football career overflowing with records and accolades. "},{"_id":"3YDYSPVUCNGGXIE4LKGEAOP5UU","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"But for all his accomplishments in one of Georgia’s most talented counties, his recruiting hasn’t drawn big-name interest."},{"_id":"5OZ2TEHP2FF5XL3EC5IQKI5WO4","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Standing at 5-foot-10, Do doesn’t look like a Division-I quarterback, though his stats make a different argument. "},{"_id":"NHQGRJYW7NCRHP42Y7ZRQILJQ4","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Do set career school records in passing touchdowns (71), completions (551), completion percentage (64%), rushing yards (2,158), rushing touchdowns (33) and yards per rush (6.4). The Touchdown Club of Gwinnett County’s Quarterback of the Year also holds Archer’s single-game records for passing yards (405) and passing touchdowns (5). "},{"_id":"2YK3VBAMSZBPLA5QLCE4NVCSDU","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Archer’s football program is just 17 years old, but it’s a Class 6A school with four region championships in Gwinnett County and several deep playoff runs. Archer has sent several quarterbacks to D-I and D-II schools. "},{"_id":"MR6VJUMR5ZA3NOBWAB33MQVPQI","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Do said Division I coaches have shown him interest, but at the end of his senior year, he has three college offers: Berry College (Division III), Kentucky Wesleyan (Division II) and Clayton State (Division II)."},{"_id":"IZBZDF6FMNGCHEASWFI5PJLL2Y","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"The lack of acknowledgment after such an impressive career could be seen as discouraging, but Do isn’t dismayed. He’s comfortable starting his hopeful road to Division I football at a lower level. "},{"_id":"6UM25XIDNNBHFNSPGGBHT3UVBQ","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"It’s not the first time he made the most of a seemingly hollow opportunity. "},{"_id":"5JEXMBKF3VFO3KALDZK4KOFNH4","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"The summer before Do’s freshman season, when he played defense, Archer’s junior varsity team was facing Dacula in a seven-on-seven game, and Archer’s quarterback couldn’t make it. "},{"_id":"JJTEBLMZBZFZLIGRTMJXTWMBMU","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Do had played quarterback on Archer’s eighth-grade team and enjoyed it, but he preferred the contact on defense. "},{"_id":"CGCJAGCDLJGSJLNEYDNZGUH3KU","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"But that day, Archer needed him to lead the offense. "},{"_id":"JB3IVMD4VZGZ3JRMQ43XTJIY4Y","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“All my teammates from GFL (Gwinnett Football League) were like, ‘He was our quarterback last year,’ so they threw me in there and I did pretty decent,” Do said. “And they made me a quarterback from there.” "},{"_id":"SAWPBNVRIVFNDFD2TGX2M2AME4","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Do led the Tigers to a 6-1 record his freshman season."},{"_id":"D6RTKUZULBH3PI72BC3SJFZAM4","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“He balled out as a freshman playing with sophomores and juniors making every play in the world,” Archer coach Dante Williams said. “He was unstoppable.” "},{"_id":"JVILYYLRRRHY5PN2J4EJKIN5YI","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"By next August, he was Archer’s varsity starter. "},{"_id":"O4SMWY6ACFHVDMJKJ2ZQHXQIBY","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Williams said Do earned the team’s loyalty in Archer’s first region game that season. The Tigers hosted Brookwood, the school that Archer’s projected starter transferred to before the season. The personal tie added extra motivation and emotion for both sides. "},{"_id":"3WJG2T2SEFFZRLR6FSEL6TR2FU","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Do led the Tigers to a 34-6 win, throwing for 236 yards and two touchdowns and rushing for another 81 yards and a touchdown. "},{"_id":"INT6DON6WFEQZPIOH3GTEJGRMU","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“I remember he had that one scramble run that he broke for 50 or 60 yards, and throwing the ball all over the yard,” Williams said. “Just for his teammates to kind of see that in a big-time homecoming game, a big-time game versus Brookwood, a lot of playoff implications at the time, because we were region foes at the time. "},{"_id":"AML64P5OKVEGVHYNA7A6WGX3VY","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“For us to pull away and in fashion we did, I think that really kind of solidified this kid’s for real.” "},{"_id":"J5CPBIDZHRE2PEEVPICLW2QZYU","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Do has capitalized on opportunities before, and he plans to do the same with his college career. His eyes are on what he could offer as a transfer."},{"_id":"VZCS66SSGJGANN4QQEK4E66OEE","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“Your one-percenters, they have it made. They can go wherever they like, but at the end of the day, everyone else is more than likely not going to sign at the level that they should be signing at,” Williams said. “So you probably will sign at a lower level than you normally would, and that’s fine. "},{"_id":"3GX4B5PGB5F2RKNKGQGVIWPZ7A","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“Go do your thing, then jump in the portal and be a chess piece on the board. You can’t really whine and complain about it.” "},{"_id":"5E3VAZ5NXFEJJHOFWB7RR4HGDY","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Do isn’t in the business of complaining. He’s focused on making the best next decision available and moving from there. "},{"_id":"6SBRYZ5JEFFP5OB7F4YQ7DRPMQ","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“I really just want to have an opportunity to keep playing, because I know me, and I know how I get,” Do said. “I know if I get that one opportunity, I keep proving people wrong, and I’ll eventually make my way to the place I want to be, and of course, that’s Division I.” "},{"_id":"VKNWTEQPWRFGJKQIJZSL6SAISM","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"While Do might not look like a typical college quarterback, he reminds Williams of a current Heisman finalist. "},{"_id":"P67I6ZQGNFDOVD5V4CLCDG4UGI","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“He is Diego Pavia 2.0,” Williams said. “He’s going to start at this school, then probably go to another school, then probably go to another one, right?”"},{"_id":"OQ4LSJ7CQNGHHJOTGTJVMBAJIY","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Williams also sees similarities between Do’s and Pavia’s play styles and profiles. "},{"_id":"CB5NPJRWWNGLZB6YE64AFFUKI4","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“Just like Diego Pavia, you know, it doesn’t really make sense. You almost can’t put it into words,” Williams said. “I mean, this guy’s not tall, he doesn’t have a really rocket arm, he wouldn’t be deadly accurate. He’s not a Michael Vick or Lamar Jackson 4.3 blazer, albeit he’s athletic, but there’s just something about him where he is elevating Vanderbilt to one of the best programs in the nation. "},{"_id":"WVHW6CH57ZHCRNYAYJYXG2LDVM","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“Jordan Do will elevate a team to be one of the most competitive in the state or nation, wherever he’s at.” "},{"_id":"FIOY3PP3IRCV3DLSXIYFKRALCE","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Williams has coached Gwinnett County talent for years. He coached at Grayson when the Rams won a 7A state title in 2016. He coached eventual Heisman Trophy winner Travis Hunter at Collins Hill. "},{"_id":"IA6N2SI2NZGCNP7323W27K3NEY","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“I’ve seen the creme de la creme of players,” Williams said. “This is just paying homage to I think what high school football is in a big-time state like Georgia, Texas or Florida where high school football means something. It’s kind of paying homage to that originating storyline.” "},{"_id":"MA554EO4QFHIVM2CKAIZFSFB2E","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"The uncommitted Do doesn’t know his next team yet, much less his path to Division I football. He does know he’s satisfied with the legacy he left at the program that raised him. "},{"_id":"CL4D2OT7L5DOFE5AOESRYXLNHM","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“I’ve been playing at Archer since I was 6 years old, and I never left,” Do said. “So my biggest compliment is probably staying and trusting the process and just leaving my statement because I broke a lot of records at Archer. That’s what I’m really most proud of.” "}],"subheadlines":{"basic":"Jodan Do has capitalized on opportunities before, and he plans to do the same with his college career. His Edgewater (Florida) team played the academy to open the 2024 season, Duke’s last year with the program."},{"_id":"ODT3GRD4PJD7VAVP7VAJWJOS4I","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“Memories that every single player will never forget,” Duke said. “Getting a chance to experience a new culture, getting a chance to experience players that are playing and learning American football that are from all over the world.”"},{"_id":"N2FOC3L23BGFHJMBEH7GRD47FE","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Duke said the NFL Academy also plans to play at Marietta next season, essentially an international home-and-home series."},{"_id":"YWMOZZVHN5B3JLUA6EE24CKHI4","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"The NFL Academy is a football development program backed by the NFL in partnership with Loughborough College and Loughborough University. The academy, led by former Calhoun and University of Georgia receiver Kris Durham, develops international prep football players with hopes of furthering their careers in American college football. "},{"_id":"JS6T2626VRFNVDEX6AKNMPHUNQ","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"It’s a unique opportunity for Marietta football, but Duke is just as excited to watch his players enjoy a new country. "},{"_id":"LCPGRREFNFBNVNHB5HGAVKF3ME","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Duke plans for the team to arrive Saturday, Aug. 15. The Blue Devils will stay, study and practice at Loughborough University every morning and enjoy different travel adventures for the rest of the day."},{"_id":"VLBTH4TPGVAUXFH63TBHEBCPZA","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“Sunday would be a day that we would hopefully make a full-day trip into London, exploring all the historical sites and aspects that London has to offer,” Duke said. “Really an education opportunity for our guys to visit one of the major world cities."},{"_id":"2C5GYHE2UFFTTGSZMRAM2JK7MA","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“Each day, we would try to have a different activity planned for our guys to go and visit different historical sites.”"},{"_id":"2KLLGA33KNH5JHNTPUYPGNSI3E","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Duke mentioned a visit to Nottingham and participation in a community service project among his weekday plans."},{"_id":"OWB3LNG5RFHGBC2YMMDPWX3BFE","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Marietta would also spend some time with the NFL Academy team throughout the week, an experience Duke said he believes would amaze his team."},{"_id":"WBP7SZTZCNF5JIQYUWMJ3FERYY","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“Our guys get a chance to get to know their team,” Duke said. “Young men from all over the world learning American football and trying to get better at American football, which I think is incredible.”"},{"_id":"Z4ZCRKVKG5FDLLYP23L7BBXU5Q","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"The location of the game has not been determined, as the NFL Academy has no “home stadium.” Duke’s Edgewater team played at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium in 2024."},{"_id":"APEACSN5OJATJHMKNOFGWLLUDE","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Edgewater won that matchup in a 51-45 shootout."},{"_id":"VI5KF6KMNVGPBFCQYAPHL6G6XI","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“We’ll have our work cut out for us against a really talented and well-coached NFL Academy team,” Duke said. “(NFL Academy coach Steve Hagen) spent a lot of time coaching in the NFL, so they’re going to be prepared.”"},{"_id":"CVVTD3PZY5CNHNCKPJS47QJBXM","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Marietta still needs to raise the funds to go. The program is accepting donations <a href=\"https://mariettafootball.com/\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"\" title=\"https://mariettafootball.com/\">on its website</a> and is searching for corporate sponsors. "},{"_id":"2CVXNFXPN5GHJGI7Y5VHYUNLME","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Aside from getting passports for his entire team, Duke said many of the nonfinancial logistics have been handled."},{"_id":"ZWJCCG2CNJFDXCMZ32FUT5IBBI","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Duke led Marietta to its best season since 2021 in his first year. The Blue Devils finished the regular season at 5-5 with wins over Hillgrove, McEachern and Walton."},{"_id":"QWMWIWGB4ND4HMDBHO47TQF6VI","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"They were eliminated in the first round of the playoffs in a 45-35 loss at Harrison."},{"_id":"VNOZU5UTWJFYFDH25KF5MVK2RM","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Duke said he hopes he has the program headed in the right direction, and he believes the trip will continue to improve his program and the lives of his players."},{"_id":"UZ7VC7EWFZBP7L5TK4FZYNUHTM","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[{"date":"2025-12-10T23:51:30.343Z","replies":[],"pos":132,"comment":" to","isNote":true,"type":"insert","user":"NANCY CLANTON","email":"Nancy.Clanton@coxinc.com"}],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“It’ll be the first time a lot of our guys have ever left the state of Georgia, let alone the country,” Duke said. “And when you get a chance to do that at 16, 17 or 18 and see the world from a different perspective, I think that experience will not only last a lifetime but hopefully open the doors for our young men to understand how big this world is and what all this world has to offer.”"}],"subheadlines":{"basic":"The NFL-supported football school in BRANCH — The NFL is the ultimate wait-until-next-year sports league. The Falcons have been waiting for eight years. "},{"_id":"QU6DF6QSUZFWRALJXKNSSMUIG4","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Make it nine years with no playoffs in 2026 for the Falcons. I don’t see how they’ll be much better next year."},{"_id":"7EE5ABGNIBFOTFDT4CG6IMBRPE","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"The quarterback will be unproven next season, as he was this year, except Michael Penix Jr. will be returning from ACL surgery. The defense has declined from good to mediocre and could lose some top performers in free agency after the season. The Falcons (4-9) will have limited resources to improve the roster. "},{"_id":"OXR3CHKMBJADTBIURFRXYZEEWA","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"They can save $35 million in cap space by releasing Kirk Cousins, but they’ll probably have to use much of it to re-sign the free agents they want to keep. The Falcons don’t own their first-round pick because they traded it to move up in this year’s draft. There probably will be about 40 players off the board before they pick."},{"_id":"46HLYR6EFBEIVE3XAVMN5EU2C4","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"The Falcons have four games left this season to create some bright spots for next year. Coach Raheem Morris said the rest of the season will be about “recapturing the moment and finding out what you could have been and what you should be doing, and then actually finding some other people.”"},{"_id":"IPECRHOB6ZEZ3I5MORVZZESNWA","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Winning is always better than losing, even if the Falcons are going nowhere. One bright spot for this season is the performance of several young players on defense. The Falcons should find out if there are others who could play bigger roles next season. They need all the help they can get. "},{"_id":"VY6RBWWU4RC4BCZPF2AAAQYD64","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"It’s possible that Falcons franchise owner Arthur Blank will replace Morris. If so, then the new coach will have to deal with a lot of the same challenges as the old one. That list is topped by the lack of clarity at quarterback."},{"_id":"7EDZFX3SEBADRL2KDWGLWGP2KE","additional_properties":{"nofollow":false,"selectedStory":false,"sponsored":false,"openInNewTab":true},"type":"interstitial_link","content":"Falcons’ Raheem Morris feels he has 100% of Arthur Blank’s support","url":"https://www.ajc.com/sports/2025/12/falcons-raheem-morris-feels-he-has-100-of-arthur-blanks-support/"},{"_id":"IE3X4LIFMNF6BDQMV63KWDZITY","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Penix has made 12 starts during his two pro seasons. He was better this year than last but performed inconsistently. Penix ranked 15th among NFL starters in Total QBR and 20th in Expected Points Added (play-by-play efficiency). Penix’s big-time throws were offset by his lack of accuracy on others."},{"_id":"R66SR66HTBHRPJXGD6FBTB5YXE","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"There’s also the matter of Penix’s reluctance to run. Falcons coaches encouraged Penix to scramble for yards more often this season because he was effective when he did it. Per Sumer Sports, Penix ranked 10th in rushing EPA among starters (just behind Lamar Jackson) but just 20th in scramble rate. Will Penix run more after his third ACL surgery?"},{"_id":"KACFHT3FANHY5AMD5OVYHDNDRA","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"The Falcons will have a good skill-position group again in 2026, headlined by running back Bijan Robinson. His production has been stymied by a drop-off in run blocking (25th in ESPN’s <a href=\"https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/46138675/2025-nfl-win-rates-top-teams-players-rankings-pass-run-block#teams\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"\">win rate</a>). Some of that can be attributed to the season-ending leg injury suffered by right tackle Kaleb McGary in August. "},{"_id":"IXQLAYKJTJED7DJ5R6X2BYH2I4","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"McGary will be 31 next season. Left tackle Jake Matthews has played admirably on a bad ankle this season, but he’ll be 34 next year. The Falcons will have to get more out of their aging offensive line in 2026."},{"_id":"ANIK4SFIE5E65HL3SMZ3OJXROE","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"The <a href=\"https://www.ajc.com/sports/2025/10/believe-it-or-not-the-falcons-finally-have-a-good-defense/\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"\">early-season improvements</a> for the Falcons’ defense turned out to be unsustainable. The Falcons rank 20th in points allowed and 18th in EPA this season. Last season, they were 23rd in points allowed and 18th in EPA. A strong finish by the defense would create optimism for 2026."},{"_id":"5XIPHAMPRBBRRB36IKVY6B6J2E","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Morris overhauled the defense this year by firing coordinator Jimmy Lake and hiring Jeff Ulbrich. General manager Terry Fontenot selected four defensive prospects in the draft, including first-round picks Jalon Walker and James Pearce Jr. The most tangible outcome of those changes is a dramatically better pass rush. "},{"_id":"KEDGWC6IHBDBDAZJFJFOFSITUU","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"The Falcons improved from 31st in sacks per pass attempt to third so far this season. They were ranked 25th in quarterback pressure percentage last season and are sixth so far this season, according to Pro Football Reference. "},{"_id":"BZ6QDBS7UFDXLNE5SGVB4DQD4Q","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"To become a truly good defense, the Falcons will have to stop relying so much on blitzing to generate an effective pass rush. Per Pro Football Reference, the Falcons have sent extra defenders at quarterbacks at a higher rate than every team except the Vikings. "},{"_id":"YCEOR2QU3BF4LLRUU3J5G3TT3Q","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Blitzing leaves vulnerabilities in coverage (the Falcons need upgrades at cornerback). Ulbrich said he didn’t use blitzes much in his previous years as a coordinator. He said he’s done it this year to generate pressure as young players learn the “art” of rushing the passer, create mismatches and loosen the pass protection with the threat of extra rushers. "},{"_id":"DEM7IUPJOVHMDBG3KZ4NXYUASA","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"“I think when this is all said and done, and we are absolutely cooking, and it’s where we want it to be, we’ll have less (blitzing),” Ulbrich said. “But I think it’s been good for us.”"},{"_id":"RWU4YFJ6ERBU5LXDBEQ3H46D7Q","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"It’s plausible that the Falcons’ young defenders will continue to improve next season. But they’ll have a limited amount of cap space to sign veteran defenders with competing needs to use it. The priorities should be to re-sign linebacker Kaden Elliss and defensive end David Onyemata, but the Falcons also need to sign a quarterback who can be serviceable until Penix returns."},{"_id":"HRI7CNARJZDGBKI7VQPCKJPGUA","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"The Falcons are due for some better luck in 2026. They are 1-5 this season in games settled by one-score margins. That statistic tends to fluctuate from year to year, so maybe the Falcons will fare better in close games next season."},{"_id":"KX7EMCTQCBFDNATMTLFF7PSXMI","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"The injury luck might improve, too. Perhaps Penix will come back early in the 9-to-12-month recovery time frame for ACL injuries and blossom into a top-line starter. The successful return of McGary and better health for No. 1 wide receiver Drake London would be a big boost. "},{"_id":"NBQQDONDPZHDRATNK2HNGZYNEY","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Then there’s the continuously sorry state of the NFC South. The Buccaneers (7-6) are nothing special. The Panthers (7-6) have leapfrogged the Falcons, but that’s smoke and mirrors. The Saints (3-10) are in shambles. "},{"_id":"OFXPNN3MYNHKFC6MULKRZ4QPBE","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Playing in a bad division hasn’t helped the Falcons become a playoff team. I don’t see things being much different for them in 2026. I could be wrong about that, but it’s been nearly a decade since the Falcons beat expectations. "},{"_id":"XJWNALXJTVDCBIOHVC3JYEXJWU","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"To expect more from the Falcons is to be disappointed. I know all about it. I <a href=\"https://www.ajc.com/sports/2025/09/after-years-of-losing-falcons-finally-will-make-playoffs-in-2025-season/\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"\">predicted they would be a playoff team this season</a>. continued alignment of our administration and university in building a championship program and I know together we’ll continue to be able to achieve great things.”"},{"_id":"QBCSKMBJ2VAW3OZ4U6MJARY4GQ","additional_properties":{"inline_comments":[],"comments":[]},"type":"text","content":"Mack was chosen Conference USA Coach of the Year and was a finalist braves-1995, not-braves\",\"from\":1,\"includeDistributor\":\"\",\"includeSections\":\"/sports/atlanta-braves, /sports/atlanta-braves-blog\",\"mustIncludeAllTags\":\"\",\"primarySize\":[[630,420],[630,420],[475,475]],\"size\":3}":{"data":[{"content_elements":[{"_id":"66KP5LNWSZECPNQD6WT7EJA6ZU","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"The Braves have done what they said they would this offseason, parting with their wealth to acquire players and not office complexes."},{"_id":"AOE4ITD5LBE6VES4QX3Y5QMZIY","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"The signings this week of two-time All-Star reliever Robert Suarez and outfielder Mike Yastrzemski are additions that, while not jaw-dropping, are smart and indicate the Braves’ willingness to spend this offseason, as they said they intended to do after last year’s belly flop."},{"_id":"QEZKZZC75NF7NANU3TI6Q3L3CM","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Look at this way: On last year’s opening day roster, the player who roughly equated to Yastrzemski (yes, a grandson of the Hall of Famer Carl Yastrzemski) was either Bryan De La Cruz or Jarred Kelenic."},{"_id":"5FALPDN6VJAZJDGOX6WYU5T4BE","additional_properties":{"nofollow":false,"selectedStory":false,"sponsored":false,"openInNewTab":true},"type":"interstitial_link","content":"Mike Yastrzemski has ‘long-term memories of rooting for the Braves’","url":"https://www.ajc.com/sports/2025/12/mike-yastrzemski-has-long-term-memories-of-rooting-for-the-braves/"},{"_id":"F4EJOJI6RNAENIIDFS2YIH5R6A","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"De La Cruz was on a one-year contract worth $860,000. Kelenic also was on a one-year deal, his worth $2.3 million."},{"_id":"KFPLQLASJZGXDA5DKRRJZDUZQE","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Yastrzemski signed a two-year contract worth $23 million."},{"_id":"MA5DAF7EX5DGZO7GL62LOGP2AE","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Similarly, the second most expensive bullpen arm after Raisel Iglesias when last year began was making $7 million (Pierce Johnson). Suarez’s deal is worth $45 million over three years."},{"_id":"M6IN7Q4PRZEHXCQOHF6ZIGYQLU","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Rather than shopping in the bargain bin, president of baseball operations and general manager Alex Anthopoulos spent aggressively to meet two needs that were part of the club’s downfall in 2025."},{"_id":"76QLUTQAZZGULK33VEY3E7BLBY","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"With the Yastrzemski and Suarez signings, the Braves exceeded their 2025 spending, according to Spotrac, having $227 million in allocated payroll for 2026 compared with $220 million for last year. But they still have room to be in the top five in MLB, an objective that team chairman Terry McGuirk indicated the club could each. (Last year’s No. 5 team spent $255 million.)"},{"_id":"HCMAEMULT5ERJEUY5SNZEG4L6M","additional_properties":{"nofollow":false,"selectedStory":false,"sponsored":false,"openInNewTab":true},"type":"interstitial_link","content":"Read more about the Braves","url":"https://www.ajc.com/sports/atlanta-braves/"},{"_id":"M4P55IL4XBHH7FBLPSTUK6YZTQ","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Other offseason matters to ponder:"},{"level":2,"_id":"ABNPZBKJGFCRFJDCZGKTQFVW7Y","additional_properties":{},"type":"header","content":"What will Suarez’s role be?"},{"_id":"UHS2ITVBXBHWRJBDRYZ4NFQYEU","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"He likely will serve as the eighth-inning setup man for Iglesias."},{"_id":"GQ7TH6IFYJEHRPEE34ILONOK2I","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"While the 34-year-old Suarez (he turns 35 in March) was a closer for the Padres — he led the National League in saves in 2025 with 40 with a .904 WHIP — he’s expected to cede that role to Iglesias, who had a rough start to last season before finishing in more typical form. (A 6.75 ERA in his first 25 appearances, and a 1.25 in his final 45.)"},{"_id":"XUJH2DSCQNF2HOGBDACJ67YN54","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"But, with two more years on his deal and Iglesias (who turns 36 in January) on a one-year contract, it’s conceivable that Suarez could move to the closer role in 2027."},{"level":2,"_id":"CDGH47OCK5DQHFNXARQWPVXQVM","additional_properties":{},"type":"header","content":"What about Yastrzemski?"},{"_id":"MVH63ITHFRC7JDU6UDMKVKEOKQ","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Particularly as catcher Sean Murphy rehabilitates the labral tear in his right hip, Yastrzemski could start in left field against right-handers while the switch-hitting Jurickson Profar serves as DH."},{"_id":"KTGD3FSCQJBRNDCAT2NDQ3WXMY","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"For his career, the left-handed Yastrzemski has shown proficiency against righties — .809 OPS and homering every 20.5 at-bats — and is a plus outfielder. As an example, that’s in the same neighborhood as third baseman Austin Riley’s overall career numbers — .826 OPS and a homer every 18.6 at-bats."},{"_id":"QTY6P3GPOZDHLBGIUNVIZPFLHM","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"After Murphy returns, Yastrzemski’s role could shift, as new manager Walt Weiss may want to spread the DH spot among catchers Murphy and Drake Baldwin and the other two outfielders, Ronald Acuña<b> </b>Jr. and Michael Harris II. In that case, Yastrzemski’s versatility (he can cover all three outfield spots) could serve the Braves well."},{"_id":"GB44RDFY35H6VB5NTFVHIHXC7M","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"With the ability to cover the DH at-bats with multiple players, it would seem that Marcell Ozuna’s days in a Braves uniform are finished after six largely productive seasons."},{"_id":"IZDBCZ22SVACBAQNHJNA7HEFNM","additional_properties":{"nofollow":false,"selectedStory":false,"sponsored":false,"openInNewTab":true},"type":"interstitial_link","content":"It seems like Cooperstown’s doors may never open for Dale Murphy","url":"https://www.ajc.com/sports/2025/12/it-seems-like-cooperstowns-doors-may-never-open-for-dale-murphy/"},{"level":2,"_id":"KVXNR5HIAFEERPKSLTQKMGR73M","additional_properties":{},"type":"header","content":"Will they sign a starting pitcher?"},{"_id":"TRBXTMB46JDFREEB3KV3JUWLEI","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"With encouraging health updates from injured starters Spencer Schwellenbach (fractured elbow), Grant Holmes (partially torn UCL), Reynaldo López (shoulder) and Spencer Strider (going into second season after UCL surgery), it appears increasingly likely that they will not. Holmes and López’s cases in particular were question marks when the offseason began, but their progress seems to have softened the team’s perceived need for starting pitching help."},{"_id":"UOO4V4N2EZHZHC5KKDSPSBACM4","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"That quartet plus ace Chris Sale along with potential starters Hurston Waldrep and Bryce Elder give the Braves seven starting options, which they could deem sufficient."},{"_id":"NZMNWSBVBZBS7OO56YKWWB4K2A","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"It would be reasonable to expect that last season’s health disaster — when all five members of the starting rotation to begin the season ended up on the injured list simultaneously — will not happen again."},{"level":2,"_id":"I5FCYIYCWZG3JPIBZG5VZFZJZY","additional_properties":{},"type":"header","content":"What about shortstop?"},{"_id":"3246J52H4FFDLGQGG45SQNVEIQ","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"It would not be a surprise if Mauricio Dubón, whom the Braves acquired in a trade with the Astros (for Nick Allen) as a versatile backup, proves to be the everyday shortstop."},{"_id":"SQXERXF5O5HMDLFPUYM7YJVXXE","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"He is not as capable at the plate as Ha-Seong Kim, the top free agent on the market at that position who finished 2026 in a Braves uniform, but not by a margin that renders Dubón an unworthy option."},{"_id":"ZOPI3SVI65H3VBZJYT2DNLAPQQ","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"For instance, Dubón’s OPS over the past three seasons is .677. Kim’s is .716. Dubón will make $6.1 million. Still on the market, Kim could command three times that, although the bet on Kim is that he will be more productive after recovering from his shoulder injury. (After finishing his season with the Braves, Kim declined a $16 million player option to stay with the club, electing free agency.)"},{"_id":"7GX2CNX4XVFUBGJZZNRIZJQSHE","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"It would be great for the Braves if it could happen, but they don’t seem likely to force it."},{"level":2,"_id":"LVS7WROLKZAQDHX7X3PNQ4RSP4","additional_properties":{},"type":"header","content":"What else could the Braves do?"},{"_id":"M4I5PDADIZBBJKAV4LGWQQPTPE","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Continuing to build the bullpen would make sense. With Joe Jiménez’s health a question mark, the Braves have Iglesias, Suarez, Aaron Bummer, Dylan Lee and then an allotment of relievers that are uncertainties."},{"_id":"3NGGOA3AVRC57ATCPV5TJNIWF4","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Pierce Johnson and Tyler Kinley, both of whom had their club options for 2026 declined, could be re-signed at lower price tags. Johnson was effective in two-plus seasons (2.91 ERA), and Kinley was effective in a brief stint after being received in a trade-deadline deal from Colorado. (A 0.72 ERA in 25 innings.)"}],"subheadlines":{"basic":""},"description":{"basic":"Rather than shopping in the bargain bin, general manager Alex Anthopoulos spent aggressively to meet two needs that And in joining the Braves, he saw certainty."},{"_id":"5FNTAOWNTZHYVITNAGIKU2GFN4","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“The No. 1 thing is the history of the organization and trying to win,” Yastrzemski said when asked what separated the Braves from his other suitors. “As I’ve gone through my career — not saying I hope it’s close to anywhere near done — but you only have so many chances to win. That was the first thing that drew me here, the strong commitment to trying to win a championship.”"},{"_id":"KIQ4Y57P7NCJXD26P5SOMGPMHA","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Yastrzemski, 35, signed a two-year, $23 million deal that includes a $7 million club option ($4 million buyout) Wednesday. It was a healthy contract for a player who will serve a part-time role. The veteran is much more effective against righties than lefties, and his outfield versatility — he can play all three spots — widens the Braves’ lineup options. The team intends to deploy a rotating designated hitter, so Yastrzemski will make it easier to get their primary outfielders — Jurickson Profar, Michael Harris II and Ronald Acuña Jr. — off their feet, too."},{"_id":"52XOKHVXUVCULFRLSBXW4JQRN4","additional_properties":{"nofollow":false,"selectedStory":false,"sponsored":false,"openInNewTab":true},"type":"interstitial_link","content":"Braves sign outfielder Mike Yastrzemski","url":"https://www.ajc.com/sports/2025/12/braves-sign-outfielder-mike-yastrzemski/"},{"_id":"H3O7U2Q4MFB3TD6MHKRPTINR4U","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"When the Braves tried to explain their idea for Yastrzemski’s role, he said he politely cut them off: “Look, I don’t care. I want to be part of an organization that wins. And with them showing the commitment to me to give me the two-year guaranteed deal, that gives me the ability to 100% buy-in and be the best teammate I can, and try to find any given way to help them out. "},{"_id":"7NNJ6GY62VFATEMD4CSE7F7JRM","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“What I’d been told is there’d be some at-bats in left (field), the DH being flexible, and there are days when I could play right, give Ronnie a DH day if he needs it. If Mike needs rest, I can spend a day in center. I’m willing to play anywhere they need me in any capacity.”"},{"_id":"MVKKGNWSX5EOXJ3KSEINE6LIFU","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Yastrzemski spent last season split between the Giants and Royals, hitting .233 with 17 homers and 46 RBIs. His 2.8 bWAR was the best of his career. He thrived with Kansas City, who was the Braves’ greatest competition for his services in free agency."},{"_id":"5V7Q4LVFEFC6NHRLA2XILJVFVI","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"This is a return to the South for Yastrzemski, who played for Vanderbilt in Nashville. He said it’s “huge” to be closer to family and friends down here. Yastrzemski said he has always admired the Braves from afar. His father, Michael, played in the Braves’ minor-league system in the mid-1980s."},{"_id":"F7LPKH4ZWFAW5OHGDQXII3NPKQ","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“Any time the Braves came through Fenway (Park in Boston), we’d always say hi to (former manager) Bobby Cox because he knew (my dad),” Yastrzemski said. “So I have these long-term memories of rooting for the Braves from afar. … The Red Sox were my team, but I always followed the Braves as my National League team. It was always those two teams. I was a huge Chipper (Jones) fan. I grew up idolizing Andruw Jones playing center field. Those were the type of plays I dreamed of making one day. "},{"_id":"TD7QEF3SJNDGXDP24NEJMWROKQ","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“So the appeal of the history is a big thing for me. I know they have a great staff, great ownership and an unbelievable front office, but they also have the history of great players that I know are still around and willing to step in and help out and bring in some great information. Those are once-in-a-lifetime opportunities.”"}],"subheadlines":{"basic":"‘I’m willing to play anywhere they need me in any capacity,’ he says."},"description":{"basic":"“The No. 1 thing is the history of the organization and trying to win,” Yastrzemski said when asked what separated the Braves from his other suitors. The right-hander will earn $13 million this season and $16 million in the next two seasons. Suarez can be a setup man for Iglesias, and he’s positioned to assume closer duties in 2027 should the Braves not re-sign their incumbent closer, who’s on a one-year, $16 million deal."},{"_id":"GKJTE2LALZE6HAH7LCFFKOICRU","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“I’m just really excited to join this club; I feel like as far as I can remember, they’ve been competitive,” Suarez said via team interpreter Franco Garcia. “I’ve really only ever heard good things about this clubhouse and this team, so I’m just excited to become a member of it.”"},{"_id":"DQFOWU6LEND3PMCVMKLBGM7CCU","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Suarez earned his second consecutive All-Star nod in 2025, posting a 2.97 ERA in 70 appearances with the Padres. Suarez owned a 2.91 ERA over his four-year career, entirely with San Diego. He also has a 2.45 ERA in 12 postseason appearances (14⅔ innings)."},{"_id":"HVTQ5VCPJBEMLK5UTQFJ3RTD4U","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"He was among the more popular free agents this winter, as numerous teams — including the Mets — had interest in adding Suarez to their bullpen. Suarez didn’t delve into negotiations with other clubs, but he reiterated everything he’d heard about the Braves helped them separate from other suitors. He was encouraged in hearing how the Braves treat their players and families, and by what he was told about Atlanta itself. His fellow Venezuelan countryman Ronald Acuña Jr. and former teammate Jurickson Profar also raved about the organization, he said."},{"_id":"OJYBFAVA4VACFPOJGCIUTZWSRE","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Suarez said he was OK with being a setup man for Iglesias and that was never deterring: “I’m willing to contribute in whatever which way and add my little grain of sand to help the team win in any way. I’m happy to do whatever the team needs.”"},{"_id":"25VLKKJ3DFFL3DAT5TIJ2SOD4E","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"The Braves have aggressively pursued pitching reinforcements this winter. They reportedly were involved with All-Star closer Edwin Diaz before he joined the Dodgers. His signing would have also required a significant financial commitment. They’d been linked with Suarez, whose signing acquisition continued president of baseball operations Alex Anthopoulos’ long-standing emphasis on investing in his bullpen."},{"_id":"57YHWK2M2RC53KA4FTBJ34M37U","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"While the Braves will probably still add at least one more reliever, their heavy lifting in the bullpen has probably concluded. “We fortified the back end, and I’m looking forward to talking more in depth with Iglesias,” Suarez said. “I think we’re going to have a really nice relationship and we’re going to get along great.”"},{"_id":"YPURIT4PKRHC5P4FI5GBG3MIIA","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Suarez is the team’s second significant signing in as many days. It added outfielder Mike Yastrzemski on a two-year, $23 million deal (with a club option) Wednesday. The Braves have spent $38 million on their 2026 payroll in signing Iglesias, Yastrzemski and Suarez."},{"_id":"MEPR7YVMVFADPD56XFP436OMFM","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Yastrzemski, who competed against Suarez in the National League West while with the Giants, spoke glowingly of his new teammate."},{"_id":"RDYRTAJJNFEAHLU5O3X7573HHU","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“An absolute stud,” Yastrzemski said of Suarez. “That was never a fun time when I saw him running in from the bullpen. It was one of those like, ‘All right, I have to grind here to find a way to put together a decent at-bat.’ You never expect to do anything great off of him. He strikes fear into other hitters. "},{"_id":"2IL6GKHPNJGORDEVQG7DULF7NI","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“I think it’s another sign of commitment from the Braves that they’re doing exactly what they should be doing to put together as competitive a team as possible. He was one of the best arms out there that was available in the back end of the bullpen. I haven’t gotten to meet him or know him personally yet, but haven’t heard a bad thing about him through the grapevine, which is some of the most important stuff. I’ve heard all good things about him.”"}],"subheadlines":{"basic":"Atlanta signs the former Padres closer to a three-year, $45 million contract."},"description":{"basic":"The Atlanta Braves signed reliever Robert Suarez to a three-year, $45 million contract Thursday. "},{"_id":"TN6MU7TXWJEOXOA25HTX3Z7F3Q","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"But when the final buzzer sounded around two hours later, Georgia had another win on its ascending resume. The Bulldogs beat Cincinnati, 84-65, in the Holiday Hoopsgiving Tournament to improve to 9-1 on the season.
