They had an 11-day break between their two most recent outings, taking time to focus on final exams as the academic semester ended. "},{"_id":"WQV5QB57GFAOPGO2FMQEH4JVTY","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Pair the layoff with the aura surrounding an NBA arena, and history proves slow starts are common for Georgia. It experienced a similar situation in 2024 when it returned from an 11-day break to face Grand Canyon in Holiday Hoopsgiving, in the same venue it played Cincinnati. The Bulldogs eked out a 73-68 victory before steamrolling Buffalo by 51 points five days later."},{"_id":"D3B3S33M7NB5DOTXXK4ZDNMPRA","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“Sometimes these environments can be difficult for young people,” White said. “I don’t think we handled that level of communication as well as we did two days ago (in practice).” "},{"_id":"O336VLZTUBETLPV6GXN7BL25CY","additional_properties":{"nofollow":false,"selectedStory":false,"sponsored":false,"openInNewTab":true},"type":"interstitial_link","content":"Jeremiah Wilkinson thriving in Georgia basketball’s offense","url":"https://www.ajc.com/sports/2025/11/jeremiah-wilkinson-thriving-in-georgia-basketballs-offense/"},{"_id":"3DNPYZPMT5FYJDICFTWKA65QFE","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"To combat the time off, the Bulldogs stepped up their already competitive scrimmages. It culminated with a practice on Thursday that junior guard Blue Cain deemed as “one of our best practices I’ve ever been a part of.” "},{"_id":"RZ7ARQ5Q7RGDZAS3NNS7EOURKY","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Georgia demonstrated excellent accountability, edge, passion and competitive spirit during the scrimmage — in the words of White — and although it didn’t translate early against the Bearcats, Cain believes it paved the way for the Bulldogs’ victory."},{"_id":"GWDDS2PSR5ECTFCKGMBMDXQP7E","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“It helped us win today’s game,” Cain said. “Even if we came out a little lackadaisical, I thought (the practice) was very similar to a game in terms of the intensity and focus. That was good, just kind of get us back into the playing mode.”"},{"_id":"HNVLS3OVXJCCZAGLZV4UKCJ5QI","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Georgia did not make a basket until Cincinnati had a 4-0 lead with around 18 minutes left in the first half. The Bulldogs were outscored 18-9 to begin the game and later faced an 11-point deficit with eight minutes before halftime. "},{"_id":"7ODKCTSPLJGW5LOCBMKPF46NQ4","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Georgia rallied and went on a 13-1 run to draw even at the break. It then outscored Cincinnati, 47-28, in the second half to earn the hard-fought win. "},{"_id":"FITVJPZZFBGZBIO5LXAUBXHGMU","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“One of our keys going into it was — they’re very physical defensively, and we wanted to kind of match their physicality on offense,” Cain said. “Early on, I thought we weren’t doing great, but I thought as the game went along, we really matched their physicality.”"},{"_id":"VRNWZR3K6RDZJLTCA4F2MJHOEM","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Cain led Georgia with a career-high 22 points, while sophomore guard Jeremiah Wilkinson notched 17. Four Bulldogs finished with double digit points, including sophomore center Somto Cyril and junior guard Marcus “Smurf” Millender. "},{"_id":"VQAGGT34ZVFIZPF4AHUBQ5RYEI","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“I just try to let the game come to me,” said Cain, who earned 12 of his 22 points on free throws."},{"_id":"OUJISZ7MJZDHHORTVJQHJXMUUU","additional_properties":{"nofollow":false,"selectedStory":false,"sponsored":false,"openInNewTab":true},"type":"interstitial_link","content":"Georgia basketball leaning on depth early in season","url":"https://www.ajc.com/sports/2025/12/georgia-basketball-leaning-on-depth-early-in-season/"},{"_id":"PJAARFCG25G3ZFL3VJLRXA3QGY","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"The Bulldogs struggled from beyond the arc, as their first nine 3-point attempts fell flat. Sophomore forward Kanon Catchings earned Georgia’s first make with around 17 minutes remaining in the game. The seconds before he took the shot marked the Bulldogs’ last time trailing in the contest. "},{"_id":"YDLE6U4VVJG6PDQV2YUTC4LXFQ","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Georgia showed it could overcome unfavorable circumstances with the win. The Bulldogs turned the ball over 10 times in the first half and shot 19% from the 3-point line for the game, but still earned a 19-point victory — their largest on a neutral site since defeating Georgia Southern by 21 points in 2001. "},{"_id":"OACXEZUL55ABPOGRCR4Y4T4PTM","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"And the outcome displayed the potential of a Georgia team who looked like it had not played in 11 days. "},{"_id":"PDWPCFAPJRDJVIBM7E3JCHY5F4","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“I think we have a high ceiling,” White said. “Our ceiling’s higher than it is right now. We’re capable of being better in certain areas than we were today.”"},{"_id":"7Q5HILR52ZFDNNZNN3D5IEGZ2U","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":""}],"subheadlines":{"basic":"Bulldogs beat Cincinnati 84-65 in State Farm Arena. "},"description":{"basic":"Georgia basketball beat Cincinnati, 84-65, in State Farm Arena during Holiday Hoopsgiving. (Jason Getz/AJC)","type":"image","distributor":{"mode":"reference","reference_id":"46cae676-4989-4b34-bc9b-906e8e9b6d59"},"url":"https://cloudfront-us-east-1.images.arcpublishing.com/ajc/NDBEHOWLTNA7TL2JDPZRALFEEU.JPG","height":3317,"resized_obj":{"0":{"src":"https://www.ajc.com/resizer/v2/NDBEHOWLTNA7TL2JDPZRALFEEU.JPG?auth=3ce52490598688f212447d228fde9b67c1cfba03029950452633d95b758edcf5&width=1260&height=840&smart=true"},"1":{"src":"https://www.ajc.com/resizer/v2/NDBEHOWLTNA7TL2JDPZRALFEEU.JPG?auth=3ce52490598688f212447d228fde9b67c1cfba03029950452633d95b758edcf5&width=1260&height=840&smart=true"},"2":{"src":"https://www.ajc.com/resizer/v2/NDBEHOWLTNA7TL2JDPZRALFEEU.JPG?auth=3ce52490598688f212447d228fde9b67c1cfba03029950452633d95b758edcf5&width=950&height=950&smart=true"}}}}],"expires":1765786081766,"lastModified":1765785961359},"{\"daysBack\":90,\"excludeDistributor\":\"\",\"from\":1,\"includeContentTypes\":\"story, gallery, flatpage\",\"includeDistributor\":\"\",\"includeSections\":\"/sports/atlanta-falcons, /sports/atlanta-falcons-blog\",\"primarySize\":[[630,420],[630,420],[475,475]],\"size\":3}":{"data":[{"content_elements":[{"_id":"CPZEJGS3SZH63KAGCXBKUEK4MI","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"TAMPA, Florida — Falcons tight end Kyle Pitts, who turned in a big game against the Bucs, is set to become a free agent at the end of the season. "},{"_id":"YAFVNYOVEJACPNU2MQOJUISNFU","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Pitts helped his situation by catching 11 of 12 targets for 166 yards and three touchdowns in the 29-28 win Thursday night at Raymond James Stadium. "},{"_id":"5UBV44AFNZBFDHLAZ46KQF7X6A","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“I just stay in the present,” Pitts said when asked about his future by The Atlanta Journal-Constitution. “I just worry about today. I got all day tomorrow and then I’ll be worrying about that. I don’t think too far past anything besides where my feet and living in the moment.”"},{"_id":"QYQXCM2M2JAARIG4O6D7E3ROAE","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"On a recent interview of the “Dukes and Bell Show” on 92.9 The Game, Pitts, who was drafted fourth overall as the highest-selected tight end in NFL history, said he wanted to return to the Falcons. "},{"_id":"PZ4MWSYCNZH3XLSCV5FLUVGYHE","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Here are five things we learned from the Falcons win over the Bucs."},{"_id":"VF26AOC42FH3HH2R6LO6H4CXPI","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"<b>1. Decision time:</b> The Falcons can discuss a contract extension, allow Pitts to reach the open market to set his value or use the transition or franchise tag on him. Last season the franchise tag number for tight ends was $13.8 million and $11.7 the transition tag."},{"_id":"QWK7B3LYLNGH3OC4PRMAYNWQ7U","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"With wide receiver Drake London out the past four games, the Falcons have leaned on Pitts to carry the passing attack, and he delivered against Tampa Bay. Over the four games without London, Pitts has been targeted 40 times and has caught 26 passes for 363 yards and three touchdowns. "},{"_id":"4P7OE6TJBVGN5BBHFXKCF7N2YQ","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“We as a team will say that (center Ryan) Neuzil sealed that game for us,” Pitts said. “Him running down behind him and getting on that ball was very influential for this offense.”"},{"_id":"3RZ7FLXHTJCBZNAJAIJFTPVVGA","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Pitts became the fourth NFL tight end with 10 or more catches, 150 or more receiving yards and three-plus receiving touchdowns in a game, joining Shannon Sharpe (1996), Kellen Winslow (1983) and Todd Christensen (1983). "},{"_id":"VQJNXQOBRBCSFAOG67U5JW44PE","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“It’s a great person to be behind or beside now,” Pitts said of Sharpe. “I just want to keep competing and try to put another one on tape.”"},{"_id":"4LKC3EDKNNCKHAZZWDYBKTEF7Q","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Pitts has a career-high 73 catches on the season. He’s caught 73 of 97 targets for a career-high catch percentage of 75.3%. He has 797 yards receiving and four touchdown. He needs another touchdown to set a new career-high and 230 yards receiving to eclipse his career-high of 1,026 set in his 2021 rookie season. "},{"_id":"WM2X73ZIXVFA7LK3OX6AHPGJ6Y","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“Kirk (Cousins) trusted me, and me trying to win my isos (isolations) — that was a big thing during the week, coach Raheem (Morris) and Kirk, as well, preached. So, just being able to win my one-on-ones and let the ball find me.”"},{"_id":"6QL6JRYTN5ATTGKVUK4DLSRYFY","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"<b>2. Humphrey holds the rookie sack record:</b> The Falcons gave James Pearce Jr. the game ball after he recorded two more sacks to reach eight, a modern-day rookie record. But the all-time record is held by Claude Humphrey, who had 11.5 sacks in his rookie season in 1968."},{"_id":"6F3S5NZKLJAITDVJ7GVBYBIYWM","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Pearce needs four sacks to surpass Humphrey, who was enshrined into the Pro Football Hall of Fame in 2014."},{"_id":"34IDVSVJ2NGMXFKGQNH42TIVQQ","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Sacks didn’t become an official stat until 1982, but the older stats have been credited after extensive film reviews. Mike Pitts (seven sacks in 1983) was the previous modern-era rookie record sack holder for the Falcons."},{"_id":"F5WYZJ2EZNH25OWQ2XR4DJH6QI","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Pearce also recorded a sack in his sixth consecutive game and became the fourth rookie since sacks became an official statistic in 1982 to record a sack in six consecutive games, joining Mike Croel (1991, Broncos), Jevon Kearse (1999, Titans) and Micah Parsons (2021, Cowboys). "},{"_id":"SPVXO6DJMJFBDGM7XPKQIYJPAM","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“We were just rushing four as one,” Pearce said. “Getting the guy off his spot.” "},{"_id":"AK3FVE4DW5G4NJ7X2532FQFGGQ","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"<b>3. Fire the analytics guy:</b> The Falcons had two failed two-point conversion attempts. The first one made no sense. The second one was necessary after the first one failed."},{"_id":"DSMJBL5ZUBESJOHSOMRPL3N2DA","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Morris needs to quit trying to play this modern-era analytics gamble like he’s playing on Madden. Just play real football. Everything would have worked out and the Falcons would have won 31-28 or gone to overtime. "},{"_id":"KZ4WU5CUKRBBVLPU4URXSLVQPU","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Morris was asked for the rationale for the gamble on the first two-point conversion with the score at 28-20."},{"_id":"CBA3OUM2SZFM5HO7KTAML5YUO4","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“Obviously wanted to get the two-point conversion right there so when you score we’re kicking it to walk off on the extra point; didn’t get it,” Morris said. “Obviously, put ourself in a position to have to get the two; didn’t get the two. Then obviously put ourself in the position to go out there and play some really good four-minute defense, get the ball back for our offense, set us up for the field goal for the win — walk off extra point, excuse me.”"},{"_id":"SNKBOFL24VBW7JC25DZBW4VIXI","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Huh? "},{"_id":"4WAZRNL7UJFYFEMWVUG6XGCUGA","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Play real football and kick the extra point."},{"_id":"QFQ6BGPWRJD4BJCDT2UMQZXIKU","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"<b>4. Kickoff coverage unit:</b> The kickoff coverage unit showed up for the game, a week after allowing a back-breaking 100-yard kickoff return to the Seahawks. "},{"_id":"5HXVGP6E45HXZL5P6TT3QYD6KI","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"They held the Bucs returners to 72 yards on three returns for an average of 24 yards per return. Bucs returner Kameron Johnson had a long return of 30 yards. "},{"_id":"M4ESQHWFW5C3JIZBZ25TISOZNQ","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"On the key kickoff after making it 28-26, Charlie Woerner pushed Bucs returner Sean Tucker out of bounds after a 27-yard return. "},{"_id":"ECZ26NQG2ZETVC5AAINIHENZSI","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"<b>5. Franchise record in penalties: </b>Perhaps because they won, the Falcons were not overly concerned about their franchise-record 19 penalties for 125 yards."},{"_id":"EFR7YYHN5NCBXBIYGGKP3MHWJU","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"There were six false starts by the offensive line, and cornerback A.J. Terrell was called for five infractions, three of which were accepted. So, the penalty total could have been even higher. "},{"_id":"GYACK2YU3VGEVHTSSSPQINGNKA","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“That was a penalty thing, telling them to call that one,” Morris said about yelling into the TV cameras after the game. “Just let them know that, and went about our business. Didn’t really know which camera it was. Just happened to be close.”"},{"_id":"GDO3KJ4SSNHMPPYQJQUHTK4FEI","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Terrell was unbothered by the calls. "},{"_id":"MAOQYYKZ3BCEVO2AYVII44ROUY","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“I mean, that’s the way it went,” Terrell said. “No need to talk to them. Just understand what type of game it is and just keep playing.”"}],"subheadlines":{"basic":"Atlanta should just play football as it debates the fate of Kyle Pitts."},"description":{"basic":"Atlanta "},{"_id":"DYKE6JCORVAVNPXBNCU6ORDMUY","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Cousins said he relied on his faith in that circumstance. "},{"_id":"DW2XAA3RMRGXPIWWNUQ4JJTCVA","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"The fourth-and-14 pass to Sills was clutch. They led just 118-117 after 76ers guard Quentin Grimes hit a tightly contested 3 by Vit Krejci with a minute to play."},{"_id":"PMBUWUUXTFBWBO64PZ7RY2IQMQ","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"But the Hawks forced the 76ers to go 0-of-2 from the field on their go-ahead attempts before Alexander-Walker was fouled. "},{"_id":"V3DZRIECLNAVLDVLURANS3FGSE","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“It was big tonight,” Hawks forward Jalen Johnson said. “Dyson (Daniels) played great. Zacch (Risacher) played great. There’s so many guys that played great. Obviously, shots weren’t falling for me and Nickeil tonight, that just shows you how deep our team is, and guys stepped up when we needed them all. So that was big.”"},{"_id":"755LPIJGQVDARKS36VOUMMLAXI","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"<b>Quick stats:</b> Daniels had 27 points and 10 rebounds. Hawks center Onyeka Okongwu had his sixth double-double of the season, finishing with 20 points, 15 rebounds. Zaccharie Risacher scored 15 points while Vit Krejci had 19 points off the bench."},{"_id":"YPMXB7ZKFVB3DJRHTNUVJRJYHM","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Jalen Johnson (12 points, 10 rebounds, 12 assists) finished with fourth consecutive triple-double."},{"level":2,"_id":"SX2IIW7VI5HCBEEBYGEK3VEE2I","additional_properties":{},"type":"header","content":"Key moment"},{"_id":"YIJYTPHQNJDF7L4Y2E2GGHMF7Q","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Late in the game, the Hawks successfully challenged an out of bounds call that officials initially ruled 76ers ball. With 2.5 to play in the game, the Hawks looked to run a sideline out of bounds play but after the 76ers defense left the Hawks no options, Johnson had to call timeout to prevent a turnover."},{"_id":"GUXNFHTCNNBJDOXQ6HU6T2N5DA","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"After the timeout the Hawks looked to run the play again and Johnson got the ball inbounds with Alexander-Walker heading into the backcourt, where he was fouled."},{"_id":"OI47DDKF5RBGJAPXGXWTJKWX7A","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"The 76ers argued that officials should have called a backcourt violation, but they’d burned their challenge earlier in the quarter and officials did not review the call. Alexander-Walker went the line and sank two free throws."},{"level":2,"_id":"EFD3R3LQ5ZBWRLTYO4STAJCSXY","additional_properties":{},"type":"header","content":"Highlight play "},{"_id":"NHLXSUWJJVEATD2KQAEYXDGQ7U","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Okongwu did a little of everything Sunday. The center has flashed his passing skills throughout his career and he did it again Sunday with a bounce pass to Daniels for a quick dunk."},{"_id":"EXRS3BQLHBB2PKVYVCE3SLJQH4","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"With 10:37 to play in the second quarter, Daniels had a quick hand off to Okongwu on the wing before slipping behind three Philadelphia defenders. Okongwu quickly thread the needle to beat them and find Daniels open in the lane."},{"subtype":"twitter","referent":{"referent_properties":{},"provider":"https://publish.x.com/oembed?url=","service":"oembed","id":"https://x.com/ATLHawks/status/2000363333862461462","type":"twitter"},"_id":"RJK6I6VKY5CLNMTHF4Q3SEB6CQ","raw_oembed":{"author_name":"Atlanta Hawks","author_url":"https://twitter.com/ATLHawks","cache_age":"3153600000","width":550,"html":"<blockquote class=\"twitter-tweet\"><p lang=\"en\" dir=\"ltr\">Dyson &amp; O rock a beautiful give &amp; go 🤩 <a href=\"https://t.co/ytegF7gPIt\">pic.twitter.com/ytegF7gPIt</a></p>&mdash; Atlanta Hawks (@ATLHawks) <a href=\"https://twitter.com/ATLHawks/status/2000363333862461462?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw\">December 15, 2025</a></blockquote>\n<script async src=\"https://platform.twitter.com/widgets.js\" charset=\"utf-8\"><\/script>\n\n","provider_url":"https://twitter.com","_id":"https://x.com/ATLHawks/status/2000363333862461462","type":"twitter","provider_name":"Twitter","version":"1.0","url":"https://twitter.com/ATLHawks/status/2000363333862461462","height":null},"type":"oembed_response"},{"level":2,"_id":"GQCISQURONEKDD7NFBGZYCNKRA","additional_properties":{},"type":"header","content":"What they said"},{"_id":"O5EGEGPOXVHH3LQALXTJOECPDQ","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“I was a little more aggressive, going downhill to score. For example, in football, scores of 0, 3, 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10 are significantly more likely than scores such as 1, 2, 4, 5 and 11, and a score of 28 is much more likely than a score of 29."},{"_id":"4XWTOPA3TVEHLABIKNFYAWU3WQ","additional_properties":{"_id":1599061149853},"type":"text","content":"Aside from the team information, shown below is each game’s rating, the probability of the favorite winning, the median score for each team and the median margin of victory for the favorite."},{"_id":"G3PORVRKVNCQ5OKFXJ2RXKM5II","additional_properties":{"_id":1599061149854},"type":"text","content":"The game rating is the rating required to win 50% of all games in an infinite round-robin competition against the expected rating of the loser of the game in proportion to how often each team would win. This rating favors games with highly rated and closely matched opponents."},{"_id":"MY2YP7TQFFEDRDDRKPRA7SJ3KM","additional_properties":{"_id":1599061149855},"type":"text","content":"The median score for each team is the score that team would achieve both less than and more than at least 50% of the time if the game were infinitely repeated. For example, if a team’s median score is 20, then at least 50% of the time, the team would score 20 points or less, and at least 50% of the time, the team would score 20 points or more. The median margin of victory is the difference between each team’s median score and, thus, the margin that the favorite would achieve both less than and more than at least 50% of the time if the game were infinitely repeated."},{"_id":"JO4BBFVDL5B3PAFHHFU6WXX7EA","type":"raw_html","content":"<style>\n    .is-sticky {\n        display: none;\n For example, in football, scores of 0, 3, 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10 are significantly more likely than scores such as 1, 2, 4, 5 and 11, and a score of 28 is much more likely than a score of 29."},{"_id":"4XWTOPA3TVEHLABIKNFYAWU3WQ","additional_properties":{"_id":1599061149853},"type":"text","content":"Aside from the team information, shown below is each game’s rating, the probability of the favorite winning, the median score for each team and the median margin of victory for the favorite."},{"_id":"G3PORVRKVNCQ5OKFXJ2RXKM5II","additional_properties":{"_id":1599061149854},"type":"text","content":"The game rating is the rating required to win 50% of all games in an infinite round-robin competition against the expected rating of the loser of the game in proportion to how often each team would win. This rating favors games with highly rated and closely matched opponents."},{"_id":"MY2YP7TQFFEDRDDRKPRA7SJ3KM","additional_properties":{"_id":1599061149855},"type":"text","content":"The median score for each team is the score that team would achieve both less than and more than at least 50% of the time if the game were infinitely repeated. For example, if a team’s median score is 20, then at least 50% of the time, the team would score 20 points or less, and at least 50% of the time, the team would score 20 points or more. The median margin of victory is the difference between each team’s median score and, thus, the margin that the favorite would achieve both less than and more than at least 50% of the time if the game administration and university in building a championship program and I know together we’ll continue to be able to achieve great things.”"},{"_id":"QBCSKMBJ2VAW3OZ4U6MJARY4GQ","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Mack was chosen Conference USA Coach of the Year and was a finalist for the 2025 Eddie Robinson National Coach of the Year Award and a semifinalist for the George Munger National Coach of the Year honor."},{"_id":"CETL7PDVKFDY3LGUMSJVSOH24Q","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“From his earliest days to our conference championship, coach Mack has led with integrity, humility, and intention, reflecting the very best of Kennesaw State Athletics,” KSU president Kathy S. Schwaig said in a news release from the school. “We celebrate him not just for the wins on the field, but for the way he cares about the players and for the strong sense of community he has built within the program.” "},{"_id":"3RUECM4T5BDPZM4UQZFJGLBBCU","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Kennesaw State defeated Jacksonville State 19-15 on Friday in Jacksonville, Alabama, to win the CUSA title. Next the Owls will meet Western Michigan in the Myrtle Beach Bowl in Conway, South Carolina, at 11 a.m. Dec. 19."},{"_id":"CLK2DJHQL5FJHKXGTNEDNGS6YU","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“Winning the Conference USA Championship in Coach Mack’s first season is a powerful affirmation of his exceptional leadership, his clarity of vision, and the championship standard he brings to our program,” athletic director Milton Overton said. “From the moment he arrived on campus, Jerry has shown an unwavering commitment to our student-athletes and to building a culture of excellence at Kennesaw State.”"}],"subheadlines":{"basic":"Mack led his team to a 10-3 record, the conference championship The Olympics, the Super Bowl, the World Series, the College Football Playoff championship game, All-Star games for the NBA, NHL and MLB."},{"_id":"PAPCD7YX5VA67BQFPA6OBM4EMQ","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"<a href=\"https://www.ajc.com/sports/2025/12/work-begins-for-atlanta-and-world-cup-now-most-teams-are-known/\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"\" title=\"https://www.ajc.com/sports/2025/12/work-begins-for-atlanta-and-world-cup-now-most-teams-are-known/\">The World Cup</a> comes next summer."},{"_id":"D2STPISB3FBFZIPDRLDKMOEHXI","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"But for this college football town, here’s an absolute plum that has never been here — the Army-Navy game."},{"_id":"AWXNHFRKNVCGFF62725EPNRQCQ","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Bound in history, pageantry and patriotism, the rivalry is unique in American sports and would be worth it for Atlanta to pursue. Take it from <a href=\"https://www.ajc.com/sports/georgia-tech/former-tech-coach-paul-johnson-tabbed-for-hall-of-fame-induction/S5F227GWRFFHXAZUJDN4YKWQKM/\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"\" title=\"https://www.ajc.com/sports/georgia-tech/former-tech-coach-paul-johnson-tabbed-for-hall-of-fame-induction/S5F227GWRFFHXAZUJDN4YKWQKM/\">Hall of Fame coach Paul Johnson</a>, who coached (and won) six Army-Navy games with the Midshipmen before moving on to Georgia Tech."},{"_id":"Q2ODMLTAMNHE3KG5QQHYDBEIN4","additional_properties":{"nofollow":false,"selectedStory":false,"sponsored":false,"openInNewTab":true},"type":"interstitial_link","content":"CFP committee grants Georgia a favorable draw to reach title game","url":"https://www.ajc.com/sports/2025/12/cfp-committee-grants-georgia-a-favorable-draw-to-reach-title-game/"},{"_id":"JH7QRPBCZVEH5DXF2HAYZH7J2E","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“If they can get it, it’s unbelievable,” Johnson told The Atlanta Journal-Constitution on Tuesday. “That should be a bucket list for everybody to try to get to that game.”"},{"_id":"J7N3JPF7I5HQJFNMPAVQKLO5KI","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"It is a spectacle. Both entire student bodies — Army’s Corps of Cadets and Navy’s Brigade of Midshipmen — attend the game and march onto the field before the game. After the game, both teams stand for the playing of the academies’ alma maters. It is a bitter and hard-fought rivalry, but one marked by respect. The teams will play for the 126th time Saturday in Baltimore."},{"_id":"USZUPCJ2HRHATAAKH4BNQSSMDM","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“It’s unlike any other game,” Johnson said. “It’d be hard to describe. You can think about your biggest rival and times it by five.”"},{"_id":"L4XA7IZ4EZGFBD45OZMNGHGPDE","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"(Ever snarky, Johnson added “I can’t imagine losing that game” — the spoils of never having lost to Army.)"},{"_id":"BGOPKXUJBBDF5HA3BS2OEETP5M","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“For me, I say this game has a soul, and no other game can claim that,” <a href=\"https://goarmywestpoint.com/staff-directory/tom-theodorakis/856\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"\" title=\"https://goarmywestpoint.com/staff-directory/tom-theodorakis/856\">Army athletic director Tom Theodorakis</a> told the AJC."},{"_id":"QHE37QWM2ZGWTMHKKUOSLFIQNA","additional_properties":{"nofollow":false,"selectedStory":false,"sponsored":false,"openInNewTab":true},"type":"interstitial_link","content":"It seems like Cooperstown’s doors may never open for Dale Murphy","url":"https://www.ajc.com/sports/2025/12/it-seems-like-cooperstowns-doors-may-never-open-for-dale-murphy/"},{"_id":"3KPRQHZCA5CLBKJOWZBYZORY5E","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Beyond that, both teams play winning football. In his past nine seasons, <a href=\"https://goarmywestpoint.com/sports/football/roster/coaches/jeff-monken/2170\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"\" title=\"https://goarmywestpoint.com/sports/football/roster/coaches/jeff-monken/2170\">Army coach Jeff Monken</a> has had five nine-win seasons. Navy is a combined 19-5 in the past two seasons. The game drew 9.4 million viewers last year, the most for the game since at least 1990."},{"_id":"NA7IBBBPUVAUJKYGYOIE77M2SE","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"The game has long been played in Philadelphia, located between the two service academies, and typically sells out Lincoln Financial Field. It’s a hard-hitting battle between young men committed to serving their country and seeking to test themselves physically and mentally."},{"_id":"EKZUTDZQQNAFZG3PNXGAL3XYQY","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“Yes, you can see it on TV and that’s great, but you feel the pride, you feel the passion and you feel Americana at its best,” said Theodorakis, who has served in the Army athletic department since 2022 and became AD earlier this year."},{"_id":"76VYZ7XENRDLBNVKLWOK5XF3UY","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Who wouldn’t want this gem of a game at Mercedes-Benz Stadium?"},{"_id":"GLXEXJ3KT5HH3NINKZL4VGVDXE","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"I mean, besides an Air Force Academy graduate?"},{"_id":"KYXSPJUELJH45NWYLRL3472SR4","additional_properties":{"nofollow":false,"selectedStory":false,"sponsored":false,"openInNewTab":true},"type":"interstitial_link","content":"Once a character in UGA-Bama rivalry, Chris Conley now tells his own stories","url":"https://www.ajc.com/sports/2025/12/once-a-character-in-uga-bama-rivalry-chris-conley-now-tells-his-own-stories/"},{"_id":"6YJOAS5QPJDVHB7OETVYMMCFKQ","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"The encouraging news here is that the idea of staging the game in Atlanta isn’t just a pipe dream. Key parties have interest in exploring the possibility. While it almost always has been played in the Northeast, leaders at both institutions are interested in taking the game outside the region and have communicated with <a href=\"https://metroatlantachamber.com/staff/dan-corso/\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"\" title=\"https://metroatlantachamber.com/staff/dan-corso/\">Atlanta Sports Council president Dan Corso</a>."},{"_id":"4C6DBTFAFJAMFLGLR6RNVQLB54","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“I think it’s healthy for Army and us to be open-minded to new possibilities,” <a href=\"https://navysports.com/staff-directory/michael-kelly/1755\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"\" title=\"https://navysports.com/staff-directory/michael-kelly/1755\">Navy AD Michael Kelly</a> told the AJC."},{"_id":"6HAOUAY22NH3BCSVE4QSL642WE","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Theodorakis, the Army AD, told the AJC that he’s aware that each city and stadium bring negative and positives, “but our job and my job in working with Michael Kelly is to make sure that we’re putting this game on the biggest stage possible and that we’re continuing to elevate the experience for our Cadet athletes and Midshipmen.”"},{"_id":"TI4MQNJKYNFX7G2SGZDYCKNKH4","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Theodorakis took it one step further in regard to a possible Atlanta bid."},{"_id":"S7INL3U5AZCE3EGPNSKRDJZQG4","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“I will tell you, the state of Georgia is important to Army — the United States Military Academy,” he said. “We’ve had a lot of great Cadet athletes from there and a lot of Cadets in general from that state that are very supportive of this institution.”"},{"_id":"BXWIG4ULMRGGJIGRIZZOQT2VH4","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"A statement from Corso to the AJC indicates that the sports council has genuine interest."},{"_id":"MREV7HNZW5FGBELKWI5EN2UXVI","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“We are excited about the potential of hosting the historic Army–Navy Game in Atlanta,” the statement reads. “Our city has a proven track record of successfully delivering many of the world’s premier sporting events and we know that we could create an incredible experience for one of America’s most iconic sporting events.”"},{"_id":"E24BAAOLJBENBMQQXDR7TZ42AM","additional_properties":{"nofollow":false,"selectedStory":false,"sponsored":false,"openInNewTab":true},"type":"interstitial_link","content":"Once so hopeful, Georgia Tech’s regular season ends with a thud","url":"https://www.ajc.com/sports/2025/11/once-so-hopeful-georgia-techs-regular-season-ends-with-a-thud/"},{"_id":"ZTNXEZC7ZZBU5MLDCOMPWQI32E","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"The statement went on to say that the council has not entered into formal discussions but looked forward to learning more once Army and Navy put out their request for proposal to start the bidding process. Landing the game would require a payout. In a 2024 report, Sportico estimated that it was around $10 million to each academy."},{"_id":"FN7UP5DRTNHAHEH62PY54CJEVA","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“It needs to make sense financially,” Theodorakis said."},{"_id":"ISRSQI2IDNFSZLONICISL7NLZI","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Probably the biggest challenge for Atlanta and any other city outside the Northeast is the transportation of both academies’ student bodies — about 4,400 students at each institution — to the game, along with possible housing."},{"_id":"4FDCVONDCZACRHDLA3IA4HU6X4","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“That’s a big part of the tradition,” Kelly said."},{"_id":"V55JHEJRRFE3BCZGACXFUSCEQ4","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Students have bused to games in Philadelphia, New Jersey, Baltimore, Washington and Boston, but that would seem asking a lot in this case."},{"_id":"KPPUQ5F3ZNFYHNCPJPMZGDZSI4","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Said Theodorakis, “We need to make sure they have a great experience, and they’re not just shipped out there.”"},{"_id":"PAOLDD226RDYJCXBQ5FHMIXSLM","additional_properties":{"nofollow":false,"selectedStory":false,"sponsored":false,"openInNewTab":true},"type":"interstitial_link","content":"From 2017: Paul Johnson’s disciples have their day at Army, Navy","url":"https://www.ajc.com/sports/paul-johnson-disciples-have-their-day/2Lb0qrHtv8F4yZ4rqHKJjM/"},{"_id":"AK5WE6NEP5AKTDYPO3RU4FNJDI","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"The <a href=\"https://navysports.com/news/2025/12/8/football-army-and-navy-to-meet-saturday-in-baltimore-for-the-commander-in-chiefs-trophy.aspx\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"\" title=\"https://navysports.com/news/2025/12/8/football-army-and-navy-to-meet-saturday-in-baltimore-for-the-commander-in-chiefs-trophy.aspx\">Army-Navy game</a> is scheduled for MetLife Stadium in New Jersey in 2026 and then Lincoln Financial Field in 2027, but is open after that."},{"_id":"UAVFUZICLBHNTP2IHIB7QUJ2JY","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"The RFP likely will go out in 2026. Kelly said that outside of interest in the Northeast, he has heard from Charlotte, North Carolina; Tampa, Florida; Orlando, Florida; and Pittsburgh along with Atlanta. Army and Navy make the decision together."},{"_id":"ZYOWB4YVQVDRPAQZXSWKNLKVDE","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"It would be great for this to happen. Unbelievable, even."},{"_id":"5QDI4TSMUZDPZMZWHB32VHKEYI","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"<i>You can now get my column sent straight to your inbox. The game will be televised on ESPN."},{"_id":"4JKYLNEPXBHZLO4KCRAU6HNQK4","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"It will be the first bowl game for Kennesaw State (10-3) in only its second season at the FBS level. Western Michigan (9-4) defeated Miami-Ohio 23-13 for the Mid-American Conference Championship on Saturday and will make its first bowl appearance since 2021. "},{"_id":"E5BR4IVV5FFJ5N7JV3Y7JTPHMU","additional_properties":{"nofollow":false,"selectedStory":false,"sponsored":false,"openInNewTab":true},"type":"interstitial_link","content":"Odom-led comeback nets Conference USA championship for Kennesaw State","url":"https://www.ajc.com/sports/2025/12/odom-led-comeback-nets-cusa-championship-for-kennesaw-state/"},{"_id":"U3XKX5AQWZFUBAK4VN23ZYQAUQ","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“It’s a great day in the history of this program, our athletic department and our university,” Kennesaw State coach Jerry Mack said. “I’m so proud of the work that this group of men has put in this season. All of that hard work has caused all their hopes and dreams to come true and, after claiming the first CUSA Championship, now they get to experience a bowl game. We’re excited to head to the Myrtle Beach Bowl and are looking forward to competing against a terrific opponent in Western Michigan.” "},{"_id":"5MV4GQW7IZAHFOFXYIWAZW5YLU","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Kennesaw State this season became only the fifth team to win at least 10 games in its second year of FBS play. Their eight-win improvement over last year’s two-win season is the fifth-largest year-over-year turnaround since 2000 and the seventh-largest in college football history. "},{"_id":"BGVXSKYPRRAV3LD56TNAYPA7KU","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"The Owls received votes in the final AP poll and the USA Today poll for the first time since moving to FBS. Their last national ranking was No. 19 in the 2022 FCS poll."},{"_id":"ZCGEG5W7DRDWZNJ66V3GGA3R74","additional_properties":{"nofollow":false,"selectedStory":false,"sponsored":false,"openInNewTab":true},"type":"interstitial_link","content":"Kennesaw State seeks to deflect distractions, focus on CUSA title game","url":"https://www.ajc.com/sports/2025/12/kennesaw-state-seeks-to-deflect-distractions-focus-on-cusa-title-game/"},{"_id":"QLX6V2CFXZEYPLYGYWY7JLDSHA","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“We all have been on this journey since Day One, whether those guys came in January with us or whether they came in the summertime with us,” Mack said. “We talk about not having any regrets and I don’t want to have any regrets looking back 5-10 years from now, because at the end of the day this team is going to be a team that comes back and they’re to celebrate at Kennesaw State.”"},{"_id":"NVJA25P2YRAMBDGLXDHRT23IUM","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Kennesaw State gave indications it was on the right path in the season opener when the Owls lost to Wake Forest 10-9. "},{"_id":"KSBSEIIZXNHY3HPQGU2Q3LZZG4","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“In the Wake Forest game, we knew we had an opportunity to win that game,” defensive tackle Tylon Dunlap said. “We fell short, but from that game, I just knew we had a special team. Because you don’t lose to a Power Four team by one point and know you missed some opportunities throughout the game. That doesn’t make you a bad team. I knew we had a special group of guys.”"},{"_id":"NOIF5D2TJNCODF4FBREWMGPZ7A","additional_properties":{"nofollow":false,"selectedStory":false,"sponsored":false,"openInNewTab":true},"type":"interstitial_link","content":"Kennesaw State quarterback has team on verge of trip to conference final","url":"https://www.ajc.com/sports/2025/11/kennesaw-state-quarterback-has-team-on-verge-of-trip-to-conference-final/"},{"_id":"ZT76JYEFTFDJPFJ56SFMKSXQVA","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"KSU’s other losses came against No. 1-ranked Indiana and to Jacksonville State, a loss they avenged in the conference championship game."},{"_id":"YNV44HNSV5DVNOKDBMVDGKQYYI","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Western Michigan began the season with three straight losses — to Michigan State, North Texas and then-No. 9 Illinois. The Broncos lost to Miami-Ohio during the regular season but got their payback by beating the RedHawks in the conference championship game. "},{"_id":"3MNI3GJOSJHU3C6W5C3XHB2PIE","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"Western Michigan features the MAC Offensive Player of the Pear in quarterback Broc Lowry and Defensive Player of the Year in defensive end Nadame Tucker. Lance Taylor was voted MAC Coach of the Year. "},{"_id":"C7UTBLLWHBATTPU6N5WGZPOTFA","additional_properties":{},"type":"text","content":"“It’s been extremely crazy, from finishing dead last in the conference and playing for a conference championship,” Dunlap said. “You know, never count yourself out. You never know what can happen. Just put the work down.
